tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rten gsum bzhengs tshul dpal 'byor rgya mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo mañju shrī ye/ rten gsum bzhugs gnas dang bcas pa'i sgrub tshul rgyas par bshad pa dpal 'byor rgya mtsho zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang 'jam dpal dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshogs gnyis rta ljang zhon pa la chibs shing / /legs bshad tsha zer thigs pa'i gzhon nu ma/ /phan bde'i 'dab stong ge sar bzhad pa'i dpal/ /'jam mgon bla ma'i nyi mas dge legs mdzod/ /thub dbang kha ba'i rdul brtsegs legs 'ongs shing / /lung dang rtog pa'i gting mtha' zad mi shes/ /mkhas mchog klu dbang kun gyi bsten pa'i gzhi/ /thub bstan rin chen 'byung gnas la phyag 'tshal/ /'gro 'di'i phun tshogs gang la rag las pa'i/ /thub bstan gnas dang 'phel bar 'gyur ba'i thabs/ /dge 'dun sde dang rten gsum bzhengs pa'i tshul/ /mdo rgyud mkhas pa'i rjes 'brang 'dir bshad bya/ /'dir/ rig pa'i gnas lnga dag la brtson par ma byas na/ /'phags mchog gis kyang thams cad mkhyen nyid mi 'gyur te/ /de lta bas na gzhan dag tshar bcad rjes gzung dang / /bdag nyid kun shes bya phyir de la de brtson byed/ /ces mdo sde brgyan las gsungs pa ltar/ spyir rig pa'i gnas lnga'i nang nas/ bzo rig pa gzhan rjes su gzung ba'i phyir du mkhas par bya dgos pa dang / khyad par skye rgu'i phan bde rgyal ba'i bstan pa la rag las shing / de yang dkon mchog gsum gyi rten la rag las pas de dag gi bzhengs tshul shes pa shin tu gal che bas bshad par bya'o/ /'di la lnga/ legs par bzhengs pa'i phan yon/ gang gis bzhengs pa'i rgyu tshogs/ gang du bzhengs pa'i sa phyogs/ gang zhig bzhengs pa'i rten gsum/ ji ltar bzhengs pa'i cho ga'o/ /dang po ni/ lung rnam 'byed las/ kun dga' ra ba gtsug lag khang / /mal stan 'tsho ba nar ma dang / /zhes sogs rdzas las byung ba'i bsod nams kyi gtso bo dge 'dun gyi sde dang / der gtsug lag khang dang /

sku gzugs dang / glegs bam dang / mchod rten bzhengs pa rnams yin par gsungs shing / gnas mal gyi gzhi dang / gso sbyong gi gzhi las gtsug lag rtseg cing ri mor bri ba dang / mchod rten bzhengs tshul dang / sku gzugs kyi 'gro don mdzad tshul dang / bsro khang sgrub tshul dang / dge 'dun bsdus nas bstan pa'i bya ba byed tshul rgyas par gsungs pa bzhin du sngon grub chen kam+bha las kyang grub pa thob nas/ bstan pa la gang phan gzigs pas/ dge 'dun gyi sde bzhugs pa las lhag pa med par gzigs nas/ rgyal por bsam bzhin du skye ba bzhes te/ bi kā ma la shī la'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa dang / jo bo chen pos kyang 'phags pa rnam grol sde la sogs pa'i rjes su zhugs te/ rgya gar du'ang gtsug lag khang du ma'i gnyer kha mdzad cing / bod du ston pa rin po che la yang 'dus byas kyi dge rtsa la/ dge 'dun gyi gnas gzhi bzhengs pa las lhag pa med pas gnas gzhi gyis shig ces nan gyis gdams pas na/ 'di dag ni phan yon shin tu che ste/ theg pa thun mong gi lugs kyis/ dkon mchog dang po gnyis sku gzugs la bya bar dus 'khor sogs nas gsungs shing / mdo du ma las/ sangs rgyas nyan thos kyi dge 'dun bye ba phrag du ma dang bcas pa la lo grangs dpag tu med par yo byad kyi bsnyen bkur byas pa las/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs ring bsrel gyi snying po can zhig 'jim pa las sgrub pa bsod nams lhag pa sogs mang du gsungs shing / gsal rgyal gyis zhus pa'i mdo las/ thub pa'i mchod rten byed dam byed bcug pa/ /mya ngan 'joms dang lus kun grims pa dang / /rin chen mdzod mang 'jig rten gtsor 'gyur zhing / /mi de dgra yi tshogs las rgyal bar 'gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi mchod rten rnams dang ni/ /sku gzugs rnams la rdul phran ci yod pa/ /de 'dra'i grangs te snyed kyi rgyal srid dang / /lha yum sa steng mi yis nges par 'thob/

/gzugs dang gzugs med khams kyi ting nge 'dzin/ /phun sum tshogs pa'i sa mchog kun myong nas/ /tha mar skye dang rga ba la sogs pa'i/ /sdug bsngal dang bral sangs rgyas go 'phang 'thob/ /'di na rgyal ba'i sku gzugs byed pa ni/ /gzugs bzang bskal bzang yon tan nye bar ldan/ /de ni dbang po sbas dang nyi ma'i 'od/ /'jig rten kun gyi mthong na dga' bar 'gyur/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gzugs bzhengs pa gang / /de yi lus ni dri ma med pa dang / /nad dang mya ngan 'jigs dang sdug bsngal bral/ /pad+ma'i nang ltar 'jam dang yangs par 'gyur/ /'di na rgyal ba'i sku gzugs byed pa gang / /bran du mi 'gyur dbul po'i rang bzhin min/ /las byed ma yin skye ba dman pa min/ /dbang po ma tshang min te skyes mchog 'gyur/ /ces sogs dang / spyan ras gzigs kyi mdo dang / mar me 'bul ba'i mdo dang / mchod rten bskor ba'i mtshan nyid la sogs pa rnams na rgyas par bzhugs shing / bslab btus kyi mjug na mdo du ma drangs nas bzhengs pa dang / bzhengs zin la zhabs tog byed pa'i phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab pa gsungs pa rnams dang / rgyud sde gong 'og kun tu bris sku sogs sgrub tshul dang / de dag gi phan yon rgyas par gsungs pa rnams blta bar bya'o/ /khyad par sher phyin gyi glegs bam bzhengs pa dang / de byang chub sems dpa' la phul ba'i bsod nams ni/ brgyad stong pa'i mchod bstod bkur bsti dang bsod nams rnams grangs kyi le'u na rgyas par bzhugs pa ltar rgyas 'bring gzhan dang / sdud pa tshigs su bcad par/ la las bde gshegs yongs su mya ngan 'das pa yis/ /zhes pa nas/ mchod rten byas mchod bsod nams des ni char mi phod/ /ces dang / bzhi brgya par/ rin chen rang bzhin mchod rten ni/ /'jig rten snyed mtho 'ga' byas pa/ /de bas sems can gcig 'dul ba/ /mchog tu spras par brjod pa yin/ /zhes gsungs shing /

'phags pa sdud par/ la las gaṅgā'i klung gi ji snyed zhing rnams na/ /sems can ji snyed 'khod kun dgra bcom nyid btul bas/ /gang gi shes rab pha rol phyin 'di yig bris te/ /sems can mchog la glegs byin bsod nams khyad par 'phags/ /zhes sogs rgyas par gsungs pa ltar/ sku gzugs ni gsung 'byon 'byon 'dra yang / glegs bam rnams ni de las ldog pas/ mkhas pa la ltos na ni sku gzugs las kyang gsung rab bzhengs pa bstan pa'i rgyun la phan zhing / mkhas rmongs spyi la ltos na ni/ lha sa'i jo bo rin po che lta bus 'gro don mdzad pa tsam/ glegs bam gyis byed par dka' bas/ sku gzugs nyid 'gro don che bar snang ngo / /des na phyogs gcig kho na la zhen nas gzhan la sdang smras byed pa spangs te/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'dzin pa la 'khor lo gsum gyi bya ba sgo du ma nas khyad med du dgos pa shes par bya la/ rang gi sgo gsum dang longs spyod kyi nus pa dang bstun/ dngos kyi yongs 'dzin gyis bzhed pa'i gtso bo dngos su sgrub cing / dngos su grub pa'i dge legs kyi bya ba gzhan gyis smon pa'i gnas dang / gang zag gzhan gyis sgrub pa mthong zhing thos pa dag la bsam pa thag pa nas yi rang bar bya'o/ ༈ /gnyis pa rgyu'i yan lag sbyin bdag rkyen gyi yan lag bzo bo/ de gnyis tshogs pa'i yo byad do/ /dang po la skyon gyi mtshan nyid ni/ sdig la mi 'dzem dad 'dun chung / /phan yon ma mthong yid mi ches/ /sgrub blo med pa'am yod na yang / /tshe 'di'i lo 'dod grags 'dod phyir/ /rkyen dang mi mtshams blo rgya che/ /ngang thung blo dog bzod sran chung / /lha dang bzo bo smod byed cing / /'gyod pa skyes nas 'phro 'jog go /yon tan gyi mtshan nyid ni/ phan yon mthong ba'i shes rab can/ /rtse gcig sems pa'i bsam gtan can/ /brtan cing spro ba'i brtson 'grus can/ /dka' spyad mi skyo bzod sran can/

/ngang ring tshig 'jam tshul khrims can/ /g.yo med gtong phod sbyin par ldan/ /lha dang bzo bor dad gus ldan/ /rim gyis dga' spro bsgom pa 'o/ ༈ /gnyis pa/ bzo bo'i skyon gyi mtshan nyid ni/ yon tan mi mkhas nga rgyal che/ /'grogs pa mi bde bkur bsti 'dod/ /'phral du tshig rtsub phugs 'dod che/ /yon rgyags bla thang tshad med 'bebs/ /des kyang mi chog rgyu cha brku/ /cung zad tsam la bzo 'phro 'jog /'gro bsdigs byed cing chang nag 'tshol/ /dge las sdig par bsgyur mkhan yin/ /bzo bo'i yon tan gyi mtshan nyid ni/ rgyud sam+pu ṭi las/ dul zhing dad ldan mang tshor bas/ /dbang po rnams gsal rnam rtog med/ /khro med lkog 'chos mi byed cing / /shin tu mkhas la spro ba che/ /bzod ldan snying rje chen po can/ /zhes dang / rgyud sdom 'byung las/ dul zhing bzo rnams kun shes la/ /cho ga mthong zhing mnyam bzhag pas/ /zhes dang / rgyud sde du ma nas gsungs pa'i phan yon spyi dang / sngags sku rnams la dbang thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pa dang / rab dge slong sogs dang / tha ma'ang bzo 'dzugs dus bsnyen gnas blangs pa'i sdom ldan dgos par gsungs te/ 'dod pa chung zhing bkur bsti sla/ /mkhas shing khengs med mkhas la mnyan/ /bzod la gzab cing rkyen ngan bzod/ /lha la gus shing spyod legs pa'o/ ༈ /gsum pa la/ yon bdag rgyu la mi gzab pa'i/ /'bras bu bzang 'dod ltas ngan yin/ /bzo bo lag cha mi gzab pa'i/ /bzo la gzab 'dod ltas ngan yin/ /zhes bya ba yin pas/ rgyu rab rin po che mchog tu gyur pa dang / gser dang / dngul dang / zangs dang / ra gan dang / li la sogs pa dang / gser ljang brdungs kyi shog bu'am mthing shog ma mtha' shog skya gang bzang yan chad/ shing dang sa rdo sogs kyang gang bzang dang dpus gang dag mi 'grub pa'i blor rgyar ma song tsam gyi rtsal 'don ched gnyer du byas nas bzo bo la g.yo rgyu med par gtad cing dang po nas lhus thengs pa shin tu gal che'o/

/bzo bos kyang skabs der dgos pa'i rgyu cha gang 'grub 'tshol grogs dang gsher mal mkhas pa dang / bzo rgyu'i go rim ma log pa dang / skabs su babs pa'i lag ca la gsar bzo rnying bcos bla bcos su ma song ba nan tan chen pos sgrub cing / dang por ha cang zhum ste g.yag shing rgyal sgor grags pa yang ma yin/ ha cang mthos te sbyin bdag rtsom par 'dor ba'i rgyur 'gro ba yang ma yin pa/ phyogs phyogs nas pha rol po gang byed kyang / rang nyid lus dang longs spyod la snying po len 'dod kyis kun nas blangs te phan tshun mthun pa gtso bor sgrub par bya yis/ thog mtha' bar gsum du kha smras dang kha mchu'i sbyor ba mi bya'o/ /gnyis ka la dgos pa'i zhal bkod pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen mdo sngags kyi bstan pa 'dzin cing 'chad par 'gyur ba'i sa phyogs dang gnas dang rten gsum gyi mtshan nyid la mkhas pa rdo rje slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa sbyin bdag dang bzo bo gnyis ka'i mgo 'don zhing lag rjes kyis phyis 'byung gi legs dpe thub pa dge rtsa thams cad rdzogs byang gi rgyur sbyor ba la mkhas pa'i mkhas pa nan tan gyis btsal zhing bsten par bya'o/ ༈ /gsum pa ni/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten la 'das pa'i phun sum tshogs pa thams cad phyi nang gi rten 'brel khyad du ma bsad cing legs par bsgrigs pa las byung ba/ rgyud sde rnams las dkyil 'khor dang de'i khang pa gang du bya ba'i sa phyogs btsal bar gsungs shing / de yang sgo du ma nas brtag pa'i thabs gsungs pa ltar/ jo bo chen po la sogs pa mkhas pa rnams kyis kyang sa spyad kyi rnam par bzhag pa mang du mdzad pa rnams la btus nas sa phyogs brtag cing blang dor la mkhas par bya ba yin te/ mthong ba dang reg pas skyon dang yon tan bskyed pa'i dug sbrul dang nor bu la sogs pa bzhin du nyes dmigs dang phan yon shin tu che ba'i phyir ro/

/de yang sngon byung gi lo rgyus thos pas brtag da ltar gyi snang tshul mthong bas brtag pa'o/ /dang po ni/ thun mong ba sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa bcu gnyis sogs bstan pa'i gnas sam/ sher phyin bshad pa'i sa phyogs lta bu rten gyi yul mchod pa'i gnas su gyur pa dang / gang zag khyad par can gyi byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas dang / chos ldan gyi bya ba khyad par can 'byung bzhin pa'am/ sngon byung nas re zhig rgyun chad pa'ang rung ste/ bya ba mi shis pas bar du ma chod pa bkra shis pa'i gnas su grags shing grub pa dang / thun mong ma yin pa rdo rje theg pa sgrub pa'i gnas su byed na/ 'dzam gling gnas mchog nyi shu rtsa bzhi'am yul so gnyis kyi nang du gtogs pa la sogs pa yid ches pa'i lo rgyus tshad mar byas te legs par gtan la 'bebs pa'i gnas rnyed na/ phyi'i sa spyad brtag pa la sogs pa mi shes pa'am ma grub kyang dge legs ngang gis 'byung la/ khyad par gnas chen gyi phan yon la yid ches pa'i dad mos yod na rten 'brel rang 'grig tu 'gro'o/ /spyir bya ba gang byed thams cad bla ma dkon mchog la blo legs par bkal/ khyad par skabs su gang babs kyi mchod gtor la sogs pa sngon du 'gro ba legs par sgrub pa dang / nyes pa bzlog pa'i don du gsol ba drag tu btab nas bstan pa dang sems can gyi don lhag bsam dag pas zhugs na/ mo dang rtsis la sogs pa'i dgos pa thams cad zhar las 'byung zhing / lam gyi rtsa ba dad pa dang / des kun nas blangs pa'i skyabs 'gro dang / de'i bslab bya thams cad gong 'phel du 'gyur bar legs par 'dod cing / nyes pa mi 'dod pa'i blo sna nam skyes dus/ bla ma dkon mchog la gsol ba 'debs shing de'i don du dge ba gang 'grub la 'bad pa gtso bor bya zhing / de ltar byed pa'i ngang nas legs par shes pas rtsis dang dpyad la sogs pa la yang blang dor bya'i/ gtso bor bya rgyu dor nas/

phywa dang mo rtsis 'ba' zhig dang du len pa la ni las 'bras khyad du gsod pa'i ltas ngan gyi 'dres yod pas spang bar bya'o/ ༈ /gnyis pa ni/ yul la dge bcu tshang ba de/ /khang sa zhing sa sa yi dge /'thung chu zhing chu chu yi dge /gam 'brog rgyang 'brog rtswa yi dge /khang shing bud shing shing gi dge /khang rdo 'thag rdo rdo yi dge /tshan gnyis 'di dag gcig yod par/ /gcig shos yod par dkon pas na/ /sngon tshe dkon pa rje gung gis/ /btsal bas la stod la tshang ma/ /dang po brgyad po tshang bar mthong / /dpyad kyi gtso bo byang skyabs shing / /lho la mdun bstan lho nub zhol/ /rgyab re nye zhing mtho ba dang / /mdun ri rings zhing dma' ba dang / /nyi ma 'char snga rgas pa phyi/ /chu rgyun g.yas su 'bab pa rnams/ /kun tshangs dpal ldan sa skya sogs/ /re re tsam las med par grags/ /sa dpyad thog ma rwa pa'i mdun rgyab dang / /gdags sribs legs par phyed pa shin tu gces/ /shar dang lho mdun gzhan gnyis rgyab tu 'dod/ /'on kyang rang rang lung pa'i shis la sogs/ /gang du kha ltas shar du byas la rtsi/ /lho dang shar gdags gzhan gnyis sribs su 'dod/ /sa la pho mo 'di ltar 'dod/ /gyong rtsub rdo ba mang ba pho/ /'jam snyem rdo nyung chu mang mo/ /mdog la brtag pa 'di lta ste/ /dkar dmar nag dang 'dres pa la/ /lha btsan bdud dang 'dre rnams gnas/ /sngo smug rin chen nor gyi dpyad/ /mdangs gsal snum chags za 'og bkram/ /gser g.yu brgyus 'dra mar khu'i snod/ /rgya zho mnan 'dra ngur pa'i rgyab/ /stag lpags rma bya'i mdongs kyi mdog /zho drod brnyal 'dra gcan gzan spu/ /me tog lug mig lta bu bzang / ༈ /ri la rgyal blon btsun mo'i ri/ /rtse mtho sked pa brjid la lhun/ /rgyab gzar mdun rnyel thu ba skyor/ /srab 'thug ya yo med par brtan/ /rtse na gangs g.ya' spangs nags 'dzoms/ /mdun nas chu dang ri yis bskor/ /g.yas brag g.yon chu zur na gshong /

/me tog bsung chags gong mo rgod/ ༈ /de 'dra ri yi rgyal po yin/ /bzang po'i ri brgyud bar ma chad/ /lho byang gzhung tshugs rtse mo mtho/ /ri phran gral bcas za 'og 'dra/ /shing mangs gcan gzan bya rgod gnas/ ༈ /de 'dra ri yi blon po yin/ /ri stod 'od 'bar smad na chu/ /de ris mtha' bskor 'thu ba skyong / /'ja' 'od rin chen ltar brgyus 'dra/ /ngos 'jam ba tshwa zug ngu med/ ༈ /de 'dra ri yi btsun mo yin/ /de gsum mdun du gnas 'debs shin tu bzang / ༈ /srog chags rdzas kyi 'dra gzugs ni/ /mi ltar 'greng la 'dug langs dang / /nyal dang 'gros dang rnyes pa lnga/ /dang po gnyis ni rab dang 'bring / /gsum pa nad 'byung gzhan gnyis ngan/ /phyug ltar 'dug dang nya ltar 'phyo/ /bya ltar lding ba rnams kyang 'bring / /rdzas gzugs nor bu rdor dril sogs/ /bzang zhing dug sbrul la sogs ngan/ /'dra gzugs 'dres na bzang ngan 'dres/ /sa la bzang dpyad lha bzhi dang / /ya rabs lnga yin yon tan dang / /phyug dang mdzes dang snying po'i sa/ /re re'ang drug cu smu yad brgyad/ /'dod pa brgyad dang yon tan brgyad/ /gang ba brgyad dang bzhad sdang brgyad/ /so sor gces dgu bzang po bcu/ /gdab 'os pa dang mi thub pa/ /nyi shu nyi shu sa yi rigs/ /bzang po drug cu rtsa gsum dang / /nor nyen nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang / /grog po chu dang shing gi dpyad/ /la sogs mkhas pas shes bya ste/ ༈ /lha bzhi shar lho nub byang du/ /stag skya bya dmar 'brug sngon po/ /rus sbal ser po zhes byar grags/ /lam dang shing mtsho brag ri 'o/ /stag la sa mda' zug pa dang / /bya la mgul rnyis bzin pa dang / /'brug sngon thag gis 'thag pa dang / /rus sbal tsha bas thebs pa ngan/ /lam la lam gzhan zug pa dang / /nags bar g.ya' yis bcad pa dang / /chu bar sa yis bcad pa dang / /brag ri gas shing grum pa 'o/ /lha bzhi gnas dang nye ring tshad/ /gom pa sum cu drug cu dang /

/dgu bcu rab 'bring tha ma 'o/ ༈ /ya rabs lnga ni thes skas dang / /grum brtsegs rgyal po gdan la bzhugs/ /gser dril g.yu yi maṇ+ḍal 'dra/ ༈ /yon tan sa ni pad ze dang / /ut+pal rin chen ljon shing rgyas/ /chos sgrigs mar me 'bar 'dra 'o/ ༈ /phyug btsan mtsho lud gzhag 'khyil dang / /glang gcer lto tshil dmar khu'i snod/ /ba lang mkhal khung lta bu 'o/ ༈ /mdzes pa rgyal pang blon po'i lkog /maṇ+ḍal dbus dang ne tso'i lce/ /par phu'am mtsho yi snying po 'dra/ /snyim pa mar spungs yar bzed dang / /dbus gshong g.yas g.yon 'khyud pa 'dra/ /sa srubs ri srubs med pa 'o/ ༈ /smu yar brgyad ni mkhal khung dang / /nu 'bur phyag rgya bsnol 'dra dang / /stag 'dzum rnga mo'i nog 'dra dang / /mar skyugs lug gi dom bal dang / /brang zhol rgyas pa lta bu 'o/ ༈ /'dod brgyad rtse mo gnam la snyag /sked pa brjid chags thu ba gdengs/ /rgyab ri 'phyongs 'dra mdun ri dma'/ /phyogs mtshams skyob cing nags shing rgyas/ /gtsang po rgya mtsho mthong ba 'o/ ༈ /yon tan rin chen brgyus 'dra dang / /dbus skyob mtha' sdud thu ba brkyangs/ /za 'og bkram 'dra gru bzhir mngon/ /rgya dpe brtsegs 'dra shang gshong med/ /mgo lus ma bral ba tshwa med/ /gad brgyad mtsho 'khyil ri bong sna/ /sha sbrang gzhag brgyangs mchin btsos 'dra/ /me long ngos dang kha sbyar bse/ /tshangs sbur bsags rnams 'dra ba 'o/ ༈ /gzhad brgyad rang ri mdog snum mtho/ /gzhan ri kun zhum dgra ri bros/ /rang phyogs kun 'dud shing thog rgyas/ /sribs bru ma mdun phyug nam mkha' yangs/ ༈ /gces dgu nam mkha' gru bzhi dang / /gangs ri la thod g.ya' ri smug /brag ri mkhar thabs spangs ri rmog /nags ri so 'dra yol ri ber/ /lu ma na lung mig 'dra 'o/ /bzang bcu dpal be sgron me 'bar/ /khal brtsegs brung rtser rgyal mtshan sgreng / /dar brkyangs bum pa mchod rten brtsegs/ /pho ltar sgeg dang na chung ltar/

/brgyan pa bcu tshang don kun 'grub/ ༈ /gdab par 'os pa nyi shu ni/ /lha dang 'dra ba'i thugs kar gdab/ /rgyal mtshan 'dra ba'i rtsa ba cha/ /dpal ltar dbus dang rgyal po'i khri/ /blon po'i 'jam snon btsun mo'i lte/ /skyes pa'i sta zur na chung steng / /mchod rten bang rim stag gi 'dzum/ /seng ge glang chen 'brug dang rta'i/ /mkhal khung g.yon dang sbrul gyi lto/ /khyung snying 'brong mjing rma bya'i mdongs/ /rnga mo'i nog dang nya 'dra'i lkog /'di dag thub na shin tu bzang / /lha yi cod paṇa rgyal mtshan rtse/ /mchod rten bum pa rgyal po'i thod/ /la sogs mi thub nyi shu spang / /pi waṃ rgyud 'dra rin po che/ /spungs 'dra la sogs drug cu gsum/ /rgyal po mkhar bas 'gying 'dra dang / /sprang po dbyug thogs rgyug 'dra sogs/ /nor nyer nyi shu rtsa brgyad yod/ /rgyas par gzhan du blta bar gyis/ /ngam brog phal cher ngan na yang / /brog rtse la khar phyi nang gyes/ /lug dang sprin pa bkram 'dra ba'i/ /bud kyis brog sgor spungs pa dang / /drang po brtsug 'dra rtsa ba ni/ /lam dang nags dang na chus chod/ /mgo lnga shing lo 'dra ba dang / /ut+pal rma bya'i mdongs 'dra bzang / ༈ /chu la'ang 'dur rgyug 'bru chad dang / /dal brjid smra lkugs la sogs pa/ /bzang ngan chu ris bcu gnyis bshad/ ༈ /shing la'ang nags chen 'thug pa dang / /skye legs 'gag tu byung ba dang / /shing chen shing phran mang po yis/ /legs par bskor na bzang po sogs/ /phal cher rang gis dpyad pas shes/ /'di dag bzang dpyad mdor bsdus te/ /ngan dpyad phal cher ldog pas shes/ /gzhan ni sa dgra bcom pa'i thabs/ /skabs su 'og tu bshad par bya/ /bzang dpyad shes nas gdab pa ni/ /gdab 'os nyi shu bshad pa dang / /pad gdong ut+pal gyes mtshams dang / /rdo rje'i 'chang bzung dril bu'i sgyer/ /ba dan lce mtshams 'phan gyi dbus/ /mkhar spel ba gam ljon shing rtse/ /gzhu 'gag nya gshul sha pho'i brang /

/lug gi dom bal bya rgod mgo /rus sbal lkog ma dpal be'i rwa/ /gos dang 'phying pa'i gong ba la/ /brungs dang nas dang mig dang ni/ /lug khyung 'dra ba'i dbus su gdab/ /mthon po'i ri la sked par bzang / /sgang dang gzar po'i sde sa dang / /skyongs kyi 'bur sa 'bur gyi skyongs/ /g.ya' dang spang gi skabs gsher mtshams/ /na dang zhing dang thang gi dbus/ /'jam po'i rtsub pa rtsub mo'i 'jam/ /de yang skabs kyi 'dod dang sbyar/ /nor 'dod nags la rtsal 'dod brag /rta dang lug la spu 'dod na/ /lam dang zhing dang spang la gdab/ /rgyal sa dpa' bo bu 'dod na/ /rgyal thugs btsun dpang stag mdzum la/ /tshe ring snyan pa bgrang thub 'dod/ /rdo rje dril bu pu sti la/ /nor rdzas rje bo dgos dgu 'dod/ /nags chen ut+pal rin chen dbus/ /mi nor zas bcud dgra 'dul 'dod/ /glang chen sha pho seng ge'i ral/ /gshin rje'i bka' nyan bkur bsti 'dod/ /dkyil 'khor rgod mgo zla tshes dbus/ /kha drag gzhan bstod bang mdzod 'dod/ /rus sbal khyung dang sgrom gyi dkyil/ ༈ /mchod rten phal cher sgang du bzhengs/ /'on kyang grong sogs shar dang ni/ /chu mig mgo dang brog ral zug /sa mtshan yod dang sa rlan che/ /srog chags mang dang rgyu srang yod/ /grong dang gnyan sar grib ma 'bab/ /shar nas chu bo res 'jog dang / /lho na shing skam yal ga med/ /nub na shing gcig kha khrag lam/ /byang na sa dgra mang po'i sar/ /mchod rten gnas gzhi sogs mi bya/ /gzhan yang gsang ba spyi brgyud las/ /mtho dman snyoms shing gtsang la snum/ /zug rngu'i nyes pa rnam par spangs/ /shar dang byang du gzhol ba yi/ /sa gzhi las rnams kun la shis/ /zhes sogs dkyil chog du ma las/ /bshad pa thams cad 'dir 'dus so/ ༈ /rgyud dang dkyil chog rnams las/ shar dang byang dma' bar dgos par bshad pa ni/ 'jig rten spyi'i shar dang byang min gyis/ sa phyogs sam/ dkyil 'khor de nyid kyi mdun dang g.yon la bzhed pa yin no/

/gnas kyi yon tan gyi gtso bo ni/ gang na sa skyongs chos ldan zhing / /skye rgu bde gnas rtsod pa med/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ chos kyi rgyal pos legs par skyong zhing skye rgu bstan pa la dad pa dang 'byor pa che zhing rtsod pa med pa gal che ste/ mdo sde brgyan las/ blo ldan gang du bsgrub pa'i yul/ /legs par rnyed dang gnas bzang dang / /sa bzang ba dang grogs bzang ba/ /rnal 'byor bde ba'i yon tan ldan/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ yo byad dang lus dang sems dang gnyis ka dang / rnal 'byor rnams la mi gnod cing phan pa bsod snyoms rtsal sla ba dang / chu bzang ba dang / gzhi bdag bzang ba dang / mthun pa'i grogs dang / nyin mo skye bo'i rgyu lugs dang / mtshan mo klag col gyi sgra chung ba sogs te mthun pa'i yul la gnas pa zhes bya ba la rkyen 'khor lo chen po bzhi'i gya gcig yin pas/ gnas kyi mtshan nyid thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa rnams legs par shes par bya ste/ blang dor la 'bad pa gal che'o/ ༈ /bzhi pa gang zhig bzhengs pa'i rten gsum la dkon mchog gsum gyi'am/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten no/ /sangs rgyas kyi rten la chos sku/ longs sku/ sprul sku'i rten no/ /dang po ni/ mchod rten du grags shing / de la yang dbye ba lngar grags te/ ༈ /rang bzhin lhun grub kyi dang / ༈ /bla na med pa'i dang / ༈ /byin gyi rlabs pa'i dang / ༈ /dngos grub 'byung ba'i dang / ༈ theg pa so so'i mchod rten no/ ༈ /dang po la/ lung mchog bla ma zhes grags pa las/ gling bzhi rmang / gser ri rab dang bcas pa bang rim/ yong 'du'i ljon shing bum par bshad pa phyi snod dang / kun gzhi rmang / rnam shes tshogs brgyad ka ba/ dbang po gzugs can bang rim/ yid dbang bum pa ste nang bcud mchod rten du bshad pa dang / rdo rje bkod pa'i rgyud las/ 'dod khams rmang gi ri bo la/ /gzugs khams bang rim khri 'phang can/ /gzugs med bum rten bum par bcas/

/sku gdung chen po rgyun du gnas/ /zhes dang / smṛ ti'i de kho na nyid drug par/ ༈ /sa yi khri 'phang zur bcu gnyis/ /gling bzhi gling phran brgyad yin te/ /bang rim bdun du brtsegs pa ni/ /gser gyi ri bdun shes par bya/ /dril bu'i dbyibs kyi bum pa ni/ /lha gnas ri rab yin zhes bya/ /bum rten 'khor lo gdub bu'i dbyibs/ /klu yi rgyal po nor rgyas yin/ /kha khyer rim pa drug ldan pa/ /'dod khams lha rigs drug tu grags/ /dbus su srog shing yar sbreng ba/ /chos dbyings zag med spros bral yin/ /'khor lo bcu bdun gyis brgyan pa/ /gzugs khams gnas rigs bcu bdun rtags/ /char khebs gzugs med khams yin te/ /chos dbyings tog tu shes par bya/ /zhes snod bcud spyir mchod rten du bshad ces zer zhing / dus 'khor du/ dkyil 'khor bzhi po bang rim dang / ri rab bum pa dang / ri rab kyi mgrin pa dang / gdong pa man chad bre dang / de yan chad skra/ chos 'khor char khebs kyi rnam par gsal ba bshad pa lta bu'o/ ༈ /gnyis pa ni/ tshad med bsam yas las byung 'bras/ /shar du byams pa rdo rje rtsegs/ /lho ru snyi rje rin chen brtsegs/ /nub tu dga' ba pad+ma brtsegs/ /byang du gtang snyoms rgya gram brtsegs/ /rang byung rin chen snang ba 'o/ /zhes pa shar du byams pa tshad med rdo rje du ma brtsegs pa la sogs pa bzhir/ thig le dbang gi rgyud ces bya ba las bshad do zhes grags so/ ༈ /gsum pa ni/ 'khor lo 'byung ba'i rgyud du grags pa las/ byin rlabs sku gdung cha brgyad gling bzhir snang / /zhes pa'i 'grel par/ shar lus 'phags na/ byams ldan bsod nams gter dang / mthar legs g.yung drung rdzogs gnyis/ lho 'dzam bu gling na thugs rje sprul pa dang / yid bzhin lhun grub gnyis/ nub ba lang spyod na dpe med bsam 'das dang / smad grags chos dbyings gnyis/ byang sgra mi snyan na yon tan rin chen brtsegs dang /

khams gsum bde rgyas sgron gyi mchod rten gnyis bzhugs par bshad do/ ༈ /bzhi pa ni/ bdud rtsi mchog gi rgyud las/ ro yi bsrung ma chen mo ni/ /ma mo chen mo brgyad bzhag go /de dag rten gnas chen mo yang / /mchod rten brgyad du rnam par bzhag /ces pa'i 'grel par/ sngon he ru kas drag po btul ba'i tshe/ yul brgyad kyi dur khrod du ma mo brgyad kyi rten dngos grub 'byung ba'i mchod rten brgyad byung ba ni/ ma ga dhar bde byed/ sing ga lar ri bo ta la/ bal por bya khri kha shor/ seng ge'i gling du ge'u dā+o na/ li yul du go ma la sa la gan+dha/ sil ba tshal du ro langs/ kha cher kā na ka za hor du bde spyod gzhon nu'i mchod rten no/ ༈ /lnga pa la/ nyan rang thig chen gyi gsum mo/ /dang po ni/ chos gos bzhi bltab kyi steng du lhung bzed spub pa la mkhar gsil btsugs pa lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ rmang gru bzhi'i steng du/ ngos bzhi zlum po bang rim bcu gnyis pa 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa can no/ /gsum pa ni/ slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis lhung gzed spub pa lta bu bim pa'am zlum po dang / khang bu lta bu dang / rgyal mtshan lta bu'i mchod rten brgyad la sogs pa'o/ /'dul ba lung las ni/ chos 'khor la gdugs dang gdugs la char khebs su btags nas/ so skye'i gdugs med pa'i byi bo/ nyan thos kyi 'bras bu'i grangs kyi gdugs/ rang rgyal gyi gdugs bdun/ sangs rgyas kyi gdugs bcu gsum char khebs tog dang bcas pa rnam pa thams cad par gsungs pa'o/ /rgyud sde so so'i dbang du byas nas bya spyod kyi mchod rten bang rim nang du bcag cing phyir 'bur ba'am/ dbus 'bur la mtha' gnyis nang du bcums pa 'khor lo bcu gnyis la sogs pa'ang bshad par grags so/ /rnal 'byor rgyud kyi sngar bshad pa'i rdo rje rtsegs pa sogs/ bla med kyi dus 'khor nas gsungs pa sogs so/ /khyad par las kyi mtha' brjod pa'i mdo las/

sprul pa mdzad pa sngon bstan phyir/ /mchod rten brgyad du sku gdung bzhag /ces bshad pa ltar/ dpal mgon klu sgrub kyis/ gnas brgyad kyi mchod rten la rnam bzhag dang bstod pa mdzad pa ltar/ ston pa 'di yi mdzad pa khyad par can la rten/ yul ljongs de dang de'i skye bo spro ba skyes te dus ston bya ba'i phyir du brtsigs pa shāka thub mchod rten brgyad du grags pa ni/ dang po/ ༈ /gnas grong khyer ser skyar dus sku bltams pa'i tshe byung ba bde gshegs mchod rten du grags pa dbyibs bla ma dag zlum po pad+ma'i 'dab ma can bang rim bzhi pa'am bdun pa/ bltams pa'i mchod rten nam pad+ma'i 'dab ma can zer gsung ba dang / chos kyi 'khor lo la gru bzhi bang rim bzhi pa sgo bzhi'am brgyad la sogs pa gsungs pa yang / snga ma la bkra shis 'byung ba'i mchod rten du 'phags pas gsungs pa/ kho bo ni de gnyis ldog par 'dod de/ gru bzhi bang rim bzhi pa glo 'bur dang bcas pa sgo rab brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ 'bring nga drug tha ma bcu drug pa'o/ ༈ /gnyis pa gnas rgyal po'i khab tu dus mngon par byang chub pa'i dus su byung ba byang chub chen por grags pa dbyibs gru bzhi bang rim bzhi pa'o/ ༈ /gsum pa gnas wa ra na sir dus chos 'khor bskor ba'i tshe byung ba chos 'khor mchod rten nam/ ye shes mchod rten du grags pa zlum po bang rim bzhi pa'am/ bdun nam brgyad du bshad pa pad+ma dang 'khor los spras pa'o/ ༈ /bzhi pa gnas gnyan yod dze ta'i tshal du dus cho 'phrul bstan pa'i tshe byung ba cho 'phrul chen po'am/ mu stegs pham mdzad du grags pa gru bzhi bang rim bzhi pa phyogs rer glo 'bur dang bcas pa'o/ ༈ /lnga pa gnas sum cu rtsa gsum du lha'i dbyar gnas mdzad/ yum la chos gsungs/ snga dro dgag dbye mdzad/ phyi dro mkha' las babs nas gsal ldan du phebs dus su byung ba/ bang rim bzhi'am brgyad pa/ ngos rer glo 'bur dang bcas pa'i glo 'bur gyi dbus na them skas yod pa lha babs sam/

sum cu'i lha'i mchod rten du grags pa'o/ ༈ /drug pa rgyal po'i khab tu lha sbyin gyis dge 'dun gyi dbyen byas pa/ mchog zung gis bsdum pa'i dus su byung ba/ dbyen 'dum sam/ 'od zer can nam/ byams ngos mchod rten du grags pa/ bang rim bzhi pa gru bzhi'i zur bzhi mnyam par bcad pa'o/ ༈ /bdun pa yangs pa can du sku tshe zla ba gsum byin gyis brlabs pa'i tshe byung ba/ rnam rgyal lam byin rlobs mchod rten du grags pa/ zlum po bang rim gsum pa'o/ ༈ /brgyad pa rtswa mchog gi grong du mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshe byung ba chos rgyal mya ngan med dam/ myang 'das mchod rten du grags pa/ bang rim med pa gdan khri'i steng du bum rten yan chad bzhugs pa'o/ /de la yang sku gdung cha brgyad du bgos pa'i mchod rten chen po brgyad/ ras tshig pa'i/ྎ ma tshig pa'iྎ sol ba'i mchod rten te bcu gcig tshems che ba lha dang srin pos khyer ba'i mchod rten/ phyis chos rgyal mya ngan med kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel bzhugs pa'i mchod rten bye ba dus gcig la bzhengs pa'i sogs dang / mya ngan las ma 'das gong du dbu skra dang sen mo'i mchod rten sogs dpag tu med de/ gtso bo snga ma brgyad du ci rigs par 'dus la/ deng sang yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel bzhugs na ni/ gang zag su'i ched du bzhengs kyang / brgyad po gang rung gi rnam pa can du/ rnam pa thams cad par bya dgos so/ /de la yang dus 'khor sogs nas 'byung ba'i mgul pa thung ba'am/ dri med 'grel pa nas bshad pa'i mgrin rings sam/ rgyu dang bzo bo sogs kyis ji bzhin ma thon na/ ji ltar 'tshams shing mdzes pa'ang bya rung zhing / ༈ /gnyis pa longs sku'i rten la'ang / rang bzhin lhun grub sogs ci rigs pa rgyud sde rnams las gsungs pa'ang shes par bya la/ bod na rgyal ba rigs lnga dang / nye ba'i sras brgyad sogs rgyan can la longs skur grags pa dang /

sprul sku kun la grags pa thun mong gi mchog gi sprul sku rab byung gi cha byad can byed pa la ltos nas grags pa ltar/ tha snyad du byar rung mod kyi/ rgyud sde nas gang bshad kyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha la sprul skus khyab pas na/ mtshan nyid du bzhag tu ni mi rung ngo / /des na longs sku dngos ni ngo bo ye shes kyi sku 'byung lus rags pa dang bral bas/ sa bcu'i byang sems las gzhan pa'i sems can la mi snang bas mtshan dpe'i cha shas phra zhing phra ba yang yongs su rdzogs pa snang ba nges pa can/ gzhi kha dog thams cad pa yin par dkar po'am/ 'bras bu ye shes kyi rang mdog sngon po gang rung du nges pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ bla med kyi dbang du byas na longs sku dang kha sbyor gyi yan lag sogs yan lag bdun du nges la/ sprul sku ni gdul bya gang la gang 'dul gyi ngor 'byung ba rags pa'i mdog can zhal phyag du ma snang ba ma nges pa yin la/ cha tshad kyi cha nas/ rang sor brgya nyer lnga pa longs sku'i sangs rgyas dang / de nas brgya bcu gnyis pa'i bar longs sku'i byang sems dang / de man chad sprul sku'i sangs rgyas byang sems te/ sangs rgyas khro bo'i cha byad shin tu khros pa la ni rang sor lnga bcu yang bshad pa sogs su shes par bya'o/ ༈ /sprul sku yongs grags rab byung gi cha byad can ni dbu reg zhabs brjen gtsug tor dang ldan pa/ zhi zhing dul la mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba/ na bza' chos gos gsum pa/ zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung dang sku mdog ser po shas che ba ste/ la la dmar po dang sngon po sogs kyang yin la zhabs bzhugs pa la/ phyag g.yon mnyam gzhag g.yas sa gnon/ mchog sbyin skyabs sbyin chos 'chad sogs dang / zhabs bzhengs stabs la g.yon chos gos kyi gra 'dzin cing / g.yas mchog sbyin skyabs sbyin gang rung dang / glang po che nor skyong 'dul ba dang / sbyin len gyi phyag rgya sogs kyang mthong ste/

mdor na mdo dang lung nas 'byung ba rgya gar mkhas pas bzhengs pa dag la brten nas rtogs par bya zhing / rgyan can zhal mang phyag mang sogs ni rgyud sde so so dang / ma mtha' de dag nas btus pa'i lha 'bum gsar rnying dag las shes par bya ste/ 'dir mang gi dogs pas ma bris so/ ༈ /chos kyi rten gyi gtso bo ni/ po sti glegs bam ste/ mdo sde chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong / rgyud sde nang tshan gsum khri gsum stong / ye shes rdo rje kun las btus las bshad la/ pha rgyud bye ba phrag drug ma rgyud bye ba phrag bcu drug theg pa thun mong gi mdo sde dung phyur brgyad/ sher phyin dung phyur lnga dang sa ya lngar bde mchog sdom 'byung du bshad cing / de dag kyang sh+lau ka'i grangs min gyi mdo rgyud kyi ming gi grangs su bshad pa sogs/ bka' yang mtha' yas shing de dag gi dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa yin la/ ༈ /thun mong min pa'i gsung gi rten ni dril bu dang bgrang phreng sogs so/ /dge 'dun la theg chen gyi dge 'dun sar gnas kyi byang sems ni/ 'jam dbyangs kyi bzhengs bkod lta bu la tshangs par spyod pa'i cha byad rab byung gi rnam pa'ang bshad cing / phal cher dbu skra zur phud lnga pa'am/ thor cog bcings pa na bza' dang rgyan du mas brgyan pa rdo rje'am/ sems dpa'i skyil krung can gzhon nu'i cha lugs 'chang ba'o/ ༈ /nyan rang ni/ rab byung gi cha byad shin tu mdzes pa 'khar gsil lhung gzed dang pu sti 'dzin pa'ang bya ste/ rang rgyal ni gtsug tor cung zad yo ba dang ldan pa'o/ ༈ /sku gsung thugs su dbye na/ zhal phyag gi rnam pa can dang / gtsug lag khang dang mchod rten la sogs pa sku'i rten/ pu sti bgrang phreng dril bu la sogs pa rol mo'i bye brag rnams gsung gi rten/ rdo rje gri gug la sogs pa'i phyag mtshan phal cher thugs kyi rten du bshad do/ /da ni de dag gi cha tshad bshad pa la/ mchod rten gyi/

sku gzugs kyi/ phyag mtshan gyi/ gsung rab kyi cha tshad do/ /dang po la/ che chung gi tshad ni gang 'byor te/ skyu ru ra'i 'bru tsam dang / dpag tshad du ma yang bshad pas so/ /de yang 'byor pa che yi bzang bas/ che ba la skyon brjod pa dang / 'byor bzhin du skyung ba ni nyes dmigs shin tu che bas so/ /rgya dpangs ni/ rgyar dpar tshad tsam du 'phang du de'i phyed pa bshad pa la/ ngos bzhi sdoms pas rgyar 'dod pa'ang yod la/ ngos re rgya yin kyang / rgya ches grags pas 'phangs su de'i phyed pa las slong mi thub pa la dgongs zhes kyang zer zhing / dkyil 'khor la mchod rten du bshad pa'ang mang bas/ dkyil 'khor gyi rgya phyed dpangs su bstan pa zhes kyang zer ro/ /de ltar na che chung gang byed kyang rang rang gi cha tshad dang ldan pa dgos pas cha tshad shes par bya la/ mchod rten yongs grags kyi dang / gzhal yas khang gi tshad do/ /dang po la dri med 'grel pa'i dang / dus 'khor gyi cha tshad do/ /dang po ni/ ༈ rgyal ba gnyis med gsung de la/ /btud nas bde gshegs mchod rten tshad/ /dri med 'grel pa las gsungs pa/ /bde blag rtogs phyir bshad par bya/ /tshangs zur rtsa thig gru bzhi dang / /ngos rer cha chen bcu gnyis sogs/ /tshegs che don chung snang mod kyi/ /kho bo ldog te 'di skad smra/ /ji tsam 'byor pa'i tshangs thig gdab/ /smad nas seng khri ci mdzes bcad/ /bad chen 'og thig bya ba'i phyir/ /tshangs thig gnyis pa'i 'debs lugs bya/ /yan chad phyed dang de phyed sogs/ /cha chen bcu gnyis ri mo bya/ /cha chen rtsa nas tog rtse'i bar/ /mchod rten srid kyi tshad yin te/ /bre yi rten nam bum khebs kyi/ /rtsa ba'i mtshams ni phyed tshad yin/ /cha chen bzhi cha cha chung ste/ /ma dang bur yang tha snyad bya/ /bad chen dpangs la cha phran gsum/ /dge ba'i rmang la cha phran gcig /bang rim bzhi po gnyis gnyis so/ /bum pa'i dpangs la cha chen gsum/ /'og nas bu gcig bum gdan bya/

/bum rtses phyed kyi tshad du sleb/ /bum khebs bum pa'i gsum char 'dod/ /bre yi dpangs la cha phran gcig /gdong la gcig dang gsum gnyis te/ /de steng pad+ma cha phran gcig /'khor lo bcu gsum mdo gzungs dang / /bcas la bcu bdun byed rnams la/ /ha cang rings pa'i skyon 'byung bas/ /re re cha phran re re bya/ /de yang chos 'khor bcu gsum po'i/ /steng du gsum gnyis gdong dang ni/ /smad du gsum cha brtsegs par bya/ /bang rim bzhi pa'ang de dang 'dra/ /thugs rje mdo gzungs ut+pal bzhin/ /smad 'jam gdeng ka cung zad gyes/ /de steng ka gzhu rgya gram ni/ /cha phran phyed kyi dpangs dang ldan/ /de steng rtsibs brgyad gsum cha'i dpangs/ /gdugs dang gdugs khebs sdom pa la/ /cha phran gcig dang gsum gnyis dpangs/ /khro gdan gcig la tog la bzhi/ /bad chen 'og tu bad chung la/ /cha phran phyed kyi dpangs bya zhing / /seng khri'i smad kyi gsum cha la/ /pad gdan ji ltar mdzes par bya/ /da ni rgya tshad bshad kyis nyon/ /tshangs thig nas gzhal bad chen gyi/ /srid la phyed dang bco lnga ste/ /rmang rten bcu gsum bang rim bzhi/ /cha phran re re nang du phri/ /bum gdan bum pa'i rtsa ba yang / /de dang 'dra pa re re zhums/ /bum stod bang rim gsum pa dang / /'dra bas cha phran bcu yi thig /bum pa'i dbus bzung bskor bas 'grub/ /bum khebs bad kyi gzhal bar bya/ /bre la gcig ste bre gdong gnyis/ /pad+ma'i rtsa ba bre dang 'dra/ /'dab rtse phyi la bu gcig gdengs/ /chos 'khor dang po de dang mnyam/ /de na de ru thig sna bzung / /bcu gsum pa yi tshangs thig nas/ /bzhi gsum gzhal bar sna bzung nas/ /thig gdab 'khor lo'i gdong 'byung ste/ /de nang cha phran phyed gcums nas/ /skam thig gdab pas brtsegs par 'byung / /ka gzhu'i srid la cha phran gnyis/ /gdugs ni 'khor lo drug pa'i tshad/ /gdugs khebs bdun pa dang mnyam zhing / /za ra tshags kyi rtsa ba ni/

/gdugs la sbyar bya shang kha'i rgya/ /bre yi gdong dang mnyam par bshad/ /bad chung dang ni seng ge'i khri/ /nang du cha phran phyed phyed zhum/ /mchod rten dkar po seng khri ljang / /rmang rten ser po mdo gzungs dang / /za ra tshags sogs bkra ba dang / /'khor lo'i gdong ser brtsegs bar dmar/ /gdong la rgyal ba'i sku sogs dang / /bar la rdo rje bya bar bshad/ /rtsibs bar rigs bzhi'i mtshan ma dang / /mtshams su yum bzhi'i mtshan ma 'am/ /sa bon lañjar bris na legs/ /'di la lho byang brje ba sogs/ /mngon sum ltar snang gtsor bzung ba'i/ /blo bzo mi bya byas gyur na/ /'jig rten lho byang 'grig snang yang / /gtso bo'i g.yas g.yon log par 'gyur/ /de las thar phyin gtso bo'i dbu/ /shar la bstan na gtso bo'i mdun/ /nub la bstan phyir rgyab mdun ldog /des na sa 'khor ji bzhin bya/ /rgyas par rab tu bshad par bya/ /'di ni byang chub chen po ste/ bang rim ma gtogs gzhan kun mtshungs/ /bang rim gsum pa bdun pa sogs/ /'di'i bang rim rgya dpangs kyi/ /sa la gsum dang bdun sogs bgo /myang 'das bang rim med pas na/ /seng khri mtho bas tshad mnyam bya/ /glo 'bur byed pa rang rang gi /ngos kyi dbus su ma yo bar/ /ngos re'i gsum cha lnga cha ni/ /rgya dang zheng du byas pas 'grub/ /glo 'bur seng khri la yang bya/ /chen po sa sogs las bzhengs na/ /bre bskyed nang du zhums rnams skyungs/ /bum pa'i sbom sa cung zad gtod/ /seng khri cung zad mtho na mdzes/ /ha cang che na bre yi tshad/ /rtsa ba nyid nas 'gram blangs shing / /de phyir nang zlum phyi gru bzhi/ /bang rim bzhi pa'i phyi tshad dang / /bum pa'i nang tshad zhum 'drongs bcas/ /nges par byas pa'i rdo 'gram la/ /nan tan bya ba shin tu gces/ /de lhag shun pa bzhin du slangs/ /seng khri'i ngos rer bug pa gsum/ /bang rim bzhi par re re dang / /bum pa'i ngos rer re re rnams/ /phyogs kun thal ba'i rlung gseng gces/

/bum gdan rtsa nas srog shing gzhug /gnod sbyin 'khor lo gzungs bzhugs sogs/ /byed tshul 'og tu 'chad ltar bya/ /'di dag rab byung cha lugs kyi/ /gtso bo'i chos gos rgyas bltab steng / /lhung gzed 'khar gsil bzhag 'dra 'o/ /'di rnams kun gyi rnam dag ni/ /slob dpon shān+ti gar+bha'i mchod rten gyi cha dbye ba las/ bad ni rjes dran drug rmang rten ni dge ba bcu/ bang rim bzhi bum gdan/ bum pa bre rnams dran pa nyer bzhag nas 'phags lam yan lag brgyad kyi bar/ srog shing ni kun rdzob shes pa la sogs pa'i shes pa bcu/ pad+ma thabs dang shes rab/ 'khor lo bcu gsum ni stobs bcu dran pa nyer bzhag gsum/ char khebs thugs rje chen po/ tog ni chos kyi sku/ mchod rten gyi 'khor la rdo ring mi 'jigs pa bzhi/ them skas srung ba med pa/ rgyal mtshan bdud bzhi las rgyal ba/ me tog gi phreng ba mtshan dpe/ rgyal chen bzhi bden pa bzhi/ dril bu gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu/ nyi zla ye shes kyi snang ba bskyed pa/ me long ye shes bzhi/ cod pan chos kyi rgyal srid 'thob pa/ ba dan ni chos kyi snyan pas kun la grags pa ste byang chub chen po'o/ ༈ /sgo mangs kyi sgo ni bden bzhi/ rnam thar brgyad/ rten 'brel bcu gnyis/ stong nyid bcu drug la sogs pa'o/ /glo 'bur ni gzhan las khyad par 'phags pas sems can gyi don mdzad pa'o/ ༈ /lha babs kyi them skas ni/ sangs rgyas rnams sems can gyi don la 'byon par mtshon pa'o/ ༈ /myang 'das la bang rim med pa ni/ 'khor ba'i 'jug pa dang bral zhing spros pa med pa'o/ ༈ /pad+ma can gyi pad+ma ni/ 'khor ba'i 'dam pas skyes kyang des ma gos pa'o/ ༈ /dbyen bsdums zur bzhi bcad pa ni/ dbyen gyi rgyu/ dug gsum lta ba dang bzhi bcad nas rnam thar zad par zil gnon brgyad mtshon pa'o/ ༈ /gnyis pa dus 'khor nas 'byung ba ni/ sangs rgyas skyil krung du bzhugs pa'i lte ba man chad bang rim/

lte 'bur bum gdan/ de nas dpung pa'i bar bum pa/ mgrin pa bre/ rkos ko nas sna rtse dang / de nas mdzod spu'i bar bre gdong / de nas ral pa'i thor cog gi bar zhal gang la chos 'khor char khebs tog dang bcas pa byed pa ste/ phyi 'jig rten gyi dkyil 'khor bzhi dang / ri rab kyi lus dang / mgrin pa gdong pa skra rnams dang tshad gcig pas phyi nang gzhan gsum sbyar ba'o/ /rnam dag kyang de nyid yin la/ cha tshad tshigs bcad du brjod na/ dus kyi 'khor lo la btud nas/ /de nas gsungs pa'i mchod rten bshad/ /ji ltar 'byor pa'i tshangs thig gdab/ /thig de dum bu lnga ru gtub/ /lnga po re re zhal re re/ /sor mo phyed bcas bcu gnyis pa/ /de lnga lus kyi gsang gnas nas/ /ya mtha' gtsug tor bar gyi ni/ /rtsa 'khor drug gi bar du bshad/ /de phyir 'og ma gdan khri'i dpangs/ /de nas zhal do bum pa'i dpangs/ /de nas zhal gang bre dang gdong / /de nas zhal gang gdugs 'phreng ngo / /'di lhag sor mo lnga bcu po/ /mchod rten dngos kyi dpangs su bshad/ /de yi phyed kyis gdan khri'i rgya/ /de dang bum pa'i ldir pa mnyam/ /de phyir zhal tshad dbus nas bskor/ /de yi phyed kyis bre gdong dang / /gdan gyi gsum cha bre mgul rgya/ /gdan dang bre dang gdong kun la/ /rang rang gsum cha glo 'bur bya/ /gdan ni sa gzhi gru bzhi nyid/ /bya bar gsung pa ma gtogs pa/ /bang rim bshad pa med pas na/ /myang 'das lta bur mngon na yang / /bad chen dang bcas seng khri ni/ /'og tu byas nas 'dir bshad gdan/ /bzhi gtubs bang rim bzhi brtsegs te/ /kun kyang glo 'bur dang bcas bya/ /bang rim sor mo gnyis gnyis zhum/ /bum pa'i smad nas sor mo bzhi/ /pad+ma'i gdan bya bum pa yi/ /sked par pad+ma'i phreng ba ni/ /kha sbyar dpangs dang bum stod nas/ /pad+mas bkab pa'ang sor bzhi 'o/ /bre mgul sor bzhi de lhag gdong / /gdugs phreng char khebs tog dang bcas/

/zhal gang po la ci mdzes te/ /mgul phra char khebs che na mdzes/ /glo 'bur kun dang pad+ma rnams/ /'bur tshad sor mo phyed dang gsum/ /sa la bzhengs na bum pa dang / /bre gdong skyung zhing gzhan rnams bskyed/ /mdzes shing dge legs 'phel bar 'gyur/ /gnyis pa la thig gi bshad pa rgyas pa ni gzhan du shes dgos shing 'dir mang par 'gyur bas bzhag la/ ༈ 'dir ni blo langs bzhengs tshul la rten pa'i log rtog snang che ba rnams bkag nas/ rang lugs gsal bar brjod par bya'o/ ༈ /'di la gzhi sna tshogs rdo rje la dang / rta babs la dang / dngos kyi dpangs la dang / yan lag gzhan la mi 'thad pa dgag pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ rwa la dang / 'thug rngams la'o/ /dang po ni/ phyis kyi mkhas pa dag phreng bar rwa rnams ni cha phran bcu drug pa'o/ /zhes pa'i lung la rten nas/ snga ma dag gi g.yas g.yon gyi rwa phyir bskyed nas bris pa dag bkag ste/ rwa so so'i dkyil thad la dbus rwa'i tshad kyi skud pas gzhal bas gang sleb las lhag pa gtan mi rung bar 'dod la/ snga ma'i rjes 'brang dag de la rmog ltar mi mdzes pa'i rnam pa 'byung ba sogs rgyu mtshan du byas nas snga ma kho na las gzhan mi rung bar 'dod do/ /kho bos ni gnyis ka yang mtha' gcig tu nges pa'i sgrub byed ma mthong ste/ phyi rabs pa'i lugs des kyang mtha' rwa'i tshad mi 'grub ste/ dbus rwa bzhi la bshad du rung bas so/ /dbus rwa dang mtha' rwa tshad mnyam du phyag mtshan rdo rje'i cha tshad kyi skabs su bshad pas mi mnyam pa mi rung ngo / /der gsum cha mnyam du bshad pas/ rwa la cha chen bzhi las lhag pa mi srid pa dang / lte ba cha chen bcu gnyis byed pa mi 'thad par 'gyur ro/ /gsum cha mnyam du phyag mtshan rdo rje'i dgos bcos yin gyis/ 'dir dkyil 'khor gdan yin pas skyon med do zhe na ni 'dir yang mtshungs so/ /des na gnyis ka ltar yang rung bar sems so/ /gnyis pa ni/ rdo rje bsnol nas lcog rtse'i steng du bzhag pa dper phyogs bzhi'i rwa 'bur bzhi sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte ba la reg cing bzhi steng du drangs thad du sgur mor byas te/

rta babs kyi mdun bkag pa ltar byed pa mi 'thad de/ de ltar na lte ba'i 'thug rngams cha chen bzhi pa las dma' ba mi rung la/ de la ni rwa yi gseng rnams shin tu ches pas/ sgo'i mdun du 'gro 'ong sogs shin tu mi bde ba'i phyir ro/ /ye shes kyi snang ba gang yang rung zhing / lha rnams nam mkha' nas thogs med 'jug pas skyon med zhe na/ 'o na sgo dang them skas dang skar khung la sogs pa mtha' dag mi dgos par 'gyur ro/ /'jig rten dang sgo bstun nas dgos na 'dir yang mtshungs so/ /des na rwa dang lte ba phyag mtshan rdo rje bzhin du mi byed pa'i dmigs bsal bzhin du/ 'dir yang lte ba cha chen gcig gi 'thug rngams las lhag pa byed don med cing / de'i cha phran gnyis steng du lhag tu bcug nas/ rwa'i 'bur cha phran gnyis pa la rtse mo lnga pa byed na'ang / gcig 'phags na gcig cung zad mngon pa tsam gyis chog go /gnyis pa la bslangs pa la dang / bslong tshul la dang / srab 'thug la mi 'thad pa dgag pa'o/ /dang po ni/ sngon dang phyis kyi bla ma kha cig sangs rgyas gsang bas byas par grags pa'i gzhung las/ sgo yi phyi zur gyi grwa bzhir/ ka ba bzhi bslong bar gsungs pa'i lung / sgo yi phyi zur bzhi po la/ /ka ba bzhi bzhis gdung sna ni/ /brgyad brgyad bteg pa rta babs rmang / /ka gdan ka gzhu ci rigs pa'o/ /zhes dang / dbus phyur bu dang bcas pa'i lcog gam/ lnga pa ltar mdzes par gyur pas so/ /zhes rigs pa ltar snang la rten nas/ sgo 'khyams kyi steng du bslong bar mdzad pa ni mi 'thad de/ sangs rgyas gsang bas byas par grags pa'i lung de/ mkhas pa dag gis bod mar bzhed pas/ brdzun lung yin pa dang / lcog gi mdzes cha las/ sgo mdun rgyan med du lus pas mdzes pa che ba'i phyir dang / ko sa lar sgo la 'jug pa'i gnas su byas nas/ de'i phyi rol tu rta babs bya bar bshad pa lta bu/ rgya bod kyi mkhas pa mang pos/

sgo bzhi'i so so'i mdun du ka ba bzhi bzhis bteg pa'i rta babs gsal bar bshad pa'i phyir dang / glang rgyab dang bcas pa'i gan+dho lar grags pa yang / rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi sgo rgyan la yod par grags pa'i phyir dang / steng du bslong ba la bri bya'i ka ba cha phran lnga pa las lhag pa mi byed na/ gzhal yas khang gi thog dpangs dmas par 'gyur zhing thog dpangs stod na ka ba bri bya las lhag pa'i blo bzo dgos par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /kha cig cha phran lnga pa'i thog dpangs nyid 'dod pa ni/ thog dngos kyi 'thug rngams la'ang cha phran gcig dgos pa na/ thog dpangs cha phran bzhi par 'gyur la/ de lta na lha snam cha phran bzhi las chung thabs med pas/ thog la gtugs par 'gyur ba'i skyon yod do/ /kha gcig dus 'khor dbang len na 'grel pa med pa'i rtsa ba/ rta babs rnams ni gsum gyis bsgyur bas bcu yi re'u mig dag tu rab tu 'gyur/ zhes pas rta babs dang dngos gzhi sgo yi gsum 'gyur du nges shing / dus 'khor ba sgo tshad re la cha phran drug pa byed pas bco brgyad dang lhag ma ka ba'i dpangs yin pas/ ka ba dus 'khor ltar na cha phran bcu gnyis pa dang / gsang sngags gzhan la brgyad par bya rgyu yin pas/ thog gi phyi'i dpangs la cha phran bdun pa bya zhing rta babs kyi 'og dang thog gi steng gnyis cha phran gcig gis ma reg pa cig grub pa yin no/ /zhes zer zhing lag len la yang byas yod par snang na yang / rgyud tshig de las 'grel pa yang med cing / 'os med kyi 'bru gnon na'ang bri bya'i skabs yin pas/ rtsa thig nas bum rtse'i bar gyi bri bya'i tshad la cha phran sum cu yod par bzhed pa yin gyis/ 'dis ka ba'i dpangs la cung zad kyang mi phan no/ /gal te phan na 'dod snam dang rtsig pa bcad nas/ ka ba bzo dgos par 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ rta babs sgo mdun du slong ba gzhir byas pa'ang / rdo rje phreng bar thig skud ring thung gnyis gsungs pas/

thung ba la rta babs sgo tshad gcig ma dpangs la byed pa de bri cha la bshad pa bzhin du sgom don slang bya'ang byed gsungs pa mi 'thad de/ gzhal yas khang dngos kyi mda' yab dang rta babs kyi mda' yab ngos mnyam byed na rgya phyed dpangs mi chung la mi mnyam par byed na sgo mdun du slong 'phro la lus pa lta bu 'byung bas/ sgo'i rgyan du mi 'gyur zhing / ka ba ring du gtong na'ang / blo bzor 'gyur ro/ /des na sgom don gyi rta babs la sgo tshad gsum mas khyab pa cig gsungs pa rnams bri cha kho na'i dbang du bya'o/ /kha cig lhung gzed che tshad chu tshad sogs kyi rig pas 'bring po sgo tshad gnyis ma yang 'dod pa ni/ gzhan de gnyis rgyud du thig skud ring thung gnyis gsungs pa yin na/ khyed kyi thig skud de ga nas gsungs pa tshol spyon cig gsum pa ni/ mkhas mchog kha cig gser dang shar bu sogs dpangs la cha phran re re las med pa ltar/ 'thug rngams kyang de dang 'dra ba thig shing brtsegs su bzhed pa grags pa dang / da lta kha cig dus 'khor thugs dkyil gyi rta babs zheng dang 'thug rngams la khad kyi gru bzhi byas 'dug pa gnyis ka yang mi 'thad de/ snga ma ni gtod mi nyan pa dang / ka ba bzhis 'degs mi shes la/ phyi ma ni gsung dkyil dpangs chung gi nang du shong thabs med pa'i phyir ro/ /des na ka ba cha phran re re ba gnyis gnyis kyi phyogs re nas 'degs dgos shing / ka ba gnyis kyi bar du cha phran gcig mi zhog pa'i thabs med la/ mtha' gnyis su'ang gser sogs gdung rnams cha phran phyed phyed ma lhag na mi mdzes pas cha phran bzhi par grub bo/ /de yang phyi 'gro'i dbang du byas kyi/ dus 'khor ltar na drug ste mdor na sgo tshad gcig go /gsum pa ni/ sngar bshad pa ltar/ kha cig cha phran lnga pa dang bdun pa 'dod pa ni/ ha cang khang leb ltar shin tu mi mdzes pa mngon sum gyis grub la/ phyis kyi rdo rje slob dpon chen po kha cig dpangs la lnga gsum dang /

rgya la nga gnyis/ kha cig de las ldog par bzhed pa dag la ni/ mdo nas bshad pa'i mchod rten gyi dpangs tshad la sogs pa'i lung gi g.yar po re tsam ma gtogs rgyu mtshan yang dag ye mi snang la/ rje btsun sa skya pa rnams dang / lo chen rin bzang rjes 'brang dang bcas pa dang / bu ston chos kyi rgyal po dang / rje btsun btsong kha pa la sogs pa rnams rgya phyed dpangs su bzhed pa ni shin tu legs mod kyis/ de dag gis kyang sgrub byed kyi rgyu mtshan yang dag ni ma rnyed par snang zhing / bu ston rin po ches/ ka ba rtsig 'gram du btsugs nas dbus su rtse mo sleb par rtse mo'i dkyil chog gi sgrub mod kyis/ khyab pa 'grub par byas kyang rtags de shin tu sgrub dka' bar snang ngo / /de thams cad kyang rta babs sgo mdun du slong ba sha stag yin la/ kho bo yang de dag gi rjes su 'brang bas/ der steng rta babs kyi dpangs bri bya la ji ltar yod pa ltar/ bslang bas rgya phyed dpangs su 'bad med du 'grub ste/ rta babs ka ba dang bcas pa'i dpangs la spyi 'gro'i cha phran bcu bdun yod la/ gzhal yas khang gi rtsig thig shar mtha' nas nub mtha'i bar la so bzhi yod pas/ phyi'i rgya phyed dpangs su grub cing / rtsa thig nas rtsa thig gi bar la so gnyis yod pa'i phyir dang / bcu drug nang gi dpangs la byas pa'i/ thog gi 'thug rngams la cha phran gcig pa 'grub bo/ /'o na mda' yab lhag go zhe na/ bya 'dab cung zad chu babs su byas pa'i sna mo la shar bu dang / de'i steng du mda' yab byed pas lhag pa yin no/ /de ltar na khyams rgya phyed dpangs su byas pa la bri bya la mi gsal ba'i ka ba brgyad kyi g.yabs sgor gyi tshul du phub cing / de'i nang du gsang 'dus gnyis lta bu gzhal yas khang gi phyed tshad du rdor phreng yod pa rnams ni de la bsten cing / kyai rdor gshed dmar lta bu pad+ma 'dab brgyad la sogs pa ma gtogs/

ka ba bri bya la med pa rnams la'ang phyed tshad kyi pad+ma'i shun bar sogs su ka ba brgyad dang des bteg pa'i gdung zlum dang / de la bsten pa'i rdo rje'i gdung bzhis mig mangs ris su bris nas thog bar pa dbub cing / de yang khyams dang cha chen gcig gi dpangs khyad yod pa chu 'bab dang bcas pa bya/ de'i mthong ka ba gru bzhir bzhag pa'i grwa bzhir ka chung btsugs nas rgya phibs steng ma phub ste/ bar der steng gi khro bo'i bzhugs pa dgos na yang byas pas rgya phibs gsum thog khang brtsegs kyi rnam pa shin tu mdzes pa 'byung ba mngon sum du 'grub ste/ rgyud dang rgya gzhung rnams su bri bya'i dbang du byas pa 'ba' zhig gsungs pas/ thog 'bub rnams mi gsal yang / rig pa'i rgyal po mtha' gzhan ma bkag pa zhes bya ba 'os med kyi rig pas 'bad med du grub kyis/ tshegs che yang don chung ba'i thog 'bubs kyi bshad pa kho bos mi shes so/ /'on kyang bde mchog la ni khyams kyi ka ba mi dgos kyi/ sku 'khor gyi ka ba la gdung bskor btang ba'i steng du khyams kyi lcam rnams ngos kyi thung ba dang zur gyi ring ba byas nas btang ste g.yabs sgor ltar bya zhing / de'i steng du ka thung btsugs pa la yang gdung skor dang / bsrung 'khor ka ba'i steng gi gdung skor gyi bar la lcam thad dkar btang zhing snga ma bzhin du rigs bsgres nas dbub par bya'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ bri bya la mun snam yod de/ gang yin kyang rta babs rnams cha phran gcig gi gzhal yas khang la ma reg par bya ba dang / glang rgyab kyi snam bu lnga pa'i steng gi ni/ zhes sogs snam bu la 'chad na/ sbab le ltar bya bar 'grub la/ thig la bshad na'ang rung bas snam bu phyed gshags sogs mi 'thad do/ /phyis kyi mkhas rloms dag kha cig 'dod snam kha khyer du bshad pas zer nas pu shu'i steng du 'gel ba dang / kha cig mtha' rin po che pha gus brtsig pa zhes sogs la bsten nas pha gu thang la phab ste 'dod snam gyi phyi ru 'jog pa sogs mang du snang mod kyis/

'dod pa rang dga' ba'i 'jug tshul la mtha' med pas/ log pa'i lam la mtha' med phyir/ /de dag 'dir ni spro bya min/ /zhes rnam nges las gsungs pa ltar/ dgag gis mi lang bas/ mkhas pa dag gi bzhed pa dgag sgrub cung zad byas so/ ༈ /gnyis pa la tshad ldan dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan dang / des na rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po la/ mi ldan pa'i nyes dmigs dang / ldan pa'i phan yon no/ /dang po ni/ bde mchog sdom 'byung gi rgyud las/ mgrin pa dkos ko byin pa ste/ /gsum po ring ba skyon chen po/ /sngags pa bdag nyid nges par ni/ /gnas las nyams shing bskrad par byed/ /snyan dang shangs dang phyag sor ste/ /gsum po thung na skyon chen po/ /dngos grub nges par 'joms pa dang / /de bzhin dpal yang nyams par 'gyur/ /byin pa zhal dang 'khur tshos te/ /gsum po sbom na skyon chen po/ /sngags pa bdag nyid nges par yang / /dpal las ring zhing bdud bgegs 'byung / /'gram pa gnyis dang rtsib logs te/ /gsum po gzhom na skyon chen po/ /don rnams nyams par 'gyur ba dang / /'dir ni bgegs 'byung the tshom med/ /nu ma shangs dang dpral ba ste/ /gsum po yo na skyon chen po/ /sgrub pa po de myur ba ni/ /dgra yi rtsod pas brdung bar 'gyur/ /brla dang kyu dang nam tshom ste/ /gsum po nyams na skyon chen po/ /chom rkun sogs kyis 'joms pa 'am/ /'chi bar 'gyur ba the tshom med/ /mig g.yon sna dang rna ba dang / /mchu dang dpral ba dag nyams na/ /nges par sngags pa rnams la ni/ /sna tshogs bgegs dang 'chi ba 'ongs/ /gyen du gzigs shing dbugs bskyod tshul/ /gdan las yo zhing bskyod 'dra na/ /rang gi gnas nas nges 'pho zhing / /don rnams 'joms par nyid du 'gyur/ /mgrin pa nam rdzong la sogs sku'i/ /skyon ni grangs med bzhin du gnas/ /'dir ni spyan sogs yo ba 'am/ /phyag rgya mtshan nor gyur pa na/ /mya ngan sdug bsngal gyis rab gdung /

/de phyir skyon rtags bcos par bya/ /rgyab yol dang ni gdugs dang gdan/ /gsum po chung zhing dog pa'i skyon/ /mdza' bos mi snyan brjod pa dang / /dpal nyams 'chi bar 'gyur ba yin/ /'di dag nyes pa chen po ste/ /legs par rnam dpyad rtag par bya/ ༈ /gnyis pa ni/ mtshan nyid thams cad yang dag rdzogs/ /gzugs mdzes cho ga mthong ba ste/ /dul ba bzo rnams thams cad la/ /legs par mnyam par bzhag pas bris/ /zhi ba la ni zhi ba'i gzugs/ /drag cing 'jigs rung drag po ste/ /dpa' zhing nga rgyal sku dpa' bo/ /bzhad pa'i zhal ni sgeg pa ste/ /'di ltar mtshan nyid mtshon byas la/ /sngags pa rnams kyis thang sku bri/ /las dang po yi sngags pa yis/ /gzugs brnyan la sogs bya ba ste/ /thang sku sgrub cha rgya chen gyis/ /dngos grub myur du thob par 'gyur/ /zhes sdom 'byung le'u sum cu par gsungs shing / 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud du'ang bris sku'i phan yon rgyas par gsungs so/ ༈ /gnyis pa ni/ sdom 'byung 'grel pa la brten pa zhig gzhan du bshad zin mod kyi/ ༈ 'dir yang dus 'khor sdom 'byung rtsa 'grel dang / kṛ ya sa muts+tsha dang / bod snga ma dag gis/ shā ri'i bus zhus pa'i mdo la brten pa'i cha tshad mang du bshad pa rnams bsgrigs te rgyas par bshad par bya'o/ /de yang zhal phyag spyan la sangs rgyas kyi sku so so dang / 'gro ba gzhan gyi lus so so'i dbang gis lus kyi sor grangs dang mchu zheng la sogs pa shes dgos te/ dus 'khor 'grel chen du/ rgyal ba'i sku la rang sor brgya nyer lnga mchu zheng mnyam pa dang / mi phal pa la zheng du rang sor go drug mchur gya bzhi las med pas mchu zheng mi dgab pa dang / de gnyis kyi bar byang sems gzhan la yod par gsungs pa cung zad zhib tu sbyar na/ mi phal pa la las rlung stong brgyad brgya pa phrag gcig 'gags/ sa dang po thob na brgya dang brgyad/ de nas sa dgu po re re la sor gnyis gnyis 'phel te brgya nyi shu rtsa bzhi/

bcu gcig pa dang bcu gnyis pa sor gcig 'phel bas brgya nyer lngar gsal bas mi mkhas pa dag rdo rje sems dpa' bzhengs pa'i tshad/ /gdong pa dgu las 'gyur ba med/ /zhi ma khro la zhal tshad brgyad/ /shin tu khros pa zhal tshad drug /ces pa ni kha bton du byed cing / zhal re sor bcu gnyis mar byed par bzhag nas/ zhal dgu la brgya dang brgyad yod pa 'di ring mthar byas te/ dus 'khor nas sor mo brgya nyer lnga dang / sdom 'byung 'grel pa sogs su zhal bcu gnyis pa yang gsungs pa rnams rang dgar 'jug pa dgag pa'i drang don du 'dod pa dag gis ni tshul 'di lta bu khong du ma chud pas nongs so/ /yang kha cig phugs kyi zhal grangs la khyad med kyang / zhi khro rnams kyi sor mo la sbom 'phra khyad yod pas/ zhal gang la sor mo phyed dang bcu drug ma dang / bcu gnyis ma dang / phyed dang bcu gcig ma dang / shin tu khros pa sor mo shin tu sbom pas zhal re re la rang sor dgu mar byed pa yin no/ /zhes kyang zer mod kyis/ de ni mi 'thad de/ shin tu khros pa de sor mo sbom pa tsam du zhal gyi 'khor yang shin tu che ba'i phyir dang / zhi ba la zhal dgu dang / zhi ma khro la brgyad/ shin tu khros pa la drug la sogs par rang gi khas blangs pa dang yang 'gal zhing / dus 'khor dang sdom 'byung du longs sku zhal tshad bcu pa/ zhal re la rang sor phyed dang bcu gsum ma dang / bde mchog sogs la sor bcu gnyis ma'i zhal bcu dang / phag mo dang bdag med ma sogs dang / tshangs pa dang dbang po nyi dbang drag po chu lha rlung lha sogs la zhal dgu pa dang / gshin rje'i gshed la sogs pa'i khro bo dang / thag bzang ris dang lus ngan dang bden bral dang gshin rje dang me lha dang drag gza' rnams la zhal brgyad pa dang / ro langs ni zhal bcu gnyis pa dang / kṛ ya sa muts+tshar mi'u thung dang tshogs bdag la sogs zhal lnga par bshad la/ 'byung po 'dul byed zhal gsum pa/

zhes nag po chen po lta bu rang zhal gsum par bshad pa'ang yod par grags pa sogs dang 'gal ba'i phyir ro/ /des na zhal grangs ni dbu che chung dang yan lag ring thung sogs kyis bzhag la/ sor grangs ni zhal so so'i bcu gnyis cha'am/ phyed dang bcu gsum cha la bzhag nas brtsi bar bya ba yin no/ /de ltar na/ dang por sor mo brgya nyer lnga pa brjod par bya ste/ gtsug tor sor mo bzhi/ de nas skra mtshams phyed dang lnga/ de nas mdzod spu sor bzhi ste de ltar zhal gang ngo / /shangs rtse kos ko/ mgrin phreng 'og ma'i bar yang ( ) de ji lta ba bzhin no/ /de nas snying lte gsang ba'i bar la zhal re re ste/ de ltar na gtsug tor nas gsang gnas kyi bar la zhal lnga'o/ /brla dang rje ngar gyi rkang la zhal do do/ dpyi dang pus mo gnyis la sor bzhi bzhi/ long bu man la phyed dang lnga ste/ de ltar gsang gnas nas rting pa'i bar la zhal lnga ste bcu po thams cad sor mo phyed dang bcu gsum par mnyam pas brgya nyer lnga/ zhabs mthil gyi dkyus la sor mo bcu bzhi ste/ de ni sku'i srid la brtsi don med do/ /kha cig de dang thor cog sbrags pas zhal do ste zhal bcu gnyis bshad zer mod kyis kho bo ni sdom 'byung 'grel par ro langs zhal bcu gnyis par bshad pa ma gtogs/ longs sku zhal bcu gnyis par bshad pa ma mthong ngo / /de bzhin du zheng du brang gi tshangs thig nas phrag pa'i bar la zhal gang / bar lhu sor nyi shu/ lag ngar bcu drug phyag mgo bcu gnyis/ gru mo dang 'khrig mar sor re re/ 'grel chen dang sdom 'byung 'grel par gsungs mod kyis/ sdom grangs drug cu re phyed dang gsum du gsungs shing / mchu zheng gab par gsungs pa dang cung mi 'grig pas na/ gru mo 'khrig ma phyag mgo rnams dus 'khor rgyud kyi rtsa bar ma thon pa 'grel pas kha bkang pa la rags rtsis shor bar snang bas/ dang po gnyis la gsum cha re dkri zhing phyi ma la sor phyed mnan par bya'o/

/'di ni sor mo brgya dang brgyad pa la ring shos byed pas bzo bo sogs kyis bltas na lhu lag shin tu ring par snang mod kyis rgyal ba nyid kyis gsungs pa 'di gtso bor bya'i/ mi phal gyi mig sngar mdzes pa gtso bor ma byed cig der ma zad cung zad khros pa'i bde mchog kyai rdor dang / dag pa'i byang sems kyi sku la ni/ zhal tshad bcu po 'di'i steng nas sor phyed phyed kyi cha phri ste/ sor mo brgya nyi shu pa byas na'ang de ltar snang mod kyi snga ma bzhin no/ /zhal tshad dgu pa rnams la ni gtsug tor sor drug nor bu sor gnyis byed kyang dgu la mi 'the bar byas/ sngar gyi sor phyed dang lnga pa thams cad bzhi pa dang zhal thams cad sor bcu gnyis par byas nas/ gzhan 'dra ba la dpyi dang pus mo'i sor bzhi po dang gtsug tor gyi sor bzhi po bor ba yin no/ /zhal tshad brgyad pa ni/ gzhan mjal lugs dgu pa ji bzhin la/ zhal gyi dbyibs dkyil 'khor gru bzhir mngon pa snga ma las che ba cig byas la/ zhal tshad gzhan thams cad zhal de'i rang sor phyed dang bcu gcig pa la zhal du ming btags shing / sor mo bzhi pa rnams phyed dang bzhi par byas pas/ zhal de'i tshad brgyad yong ba yin zhing / drug pa dang lnga pa dang gsum pa sogs kyang des 'gres nas shes par bya'o/ /dper na zhal lnga pa la bcu pa dang bzhi khyon mnyam pa la zhal nyis 'gyur gyis che bar byas/ zhal tshad gzhan thams cad de'i phyed phyed la ming du btags pa bzhin no/ /de bzhin du zhal gyi rnam pa yang / khyim bya'i sgo nga til rnam pa/ /gru bzhi dang ni zlum por bcas/ /thun mong sku rnams thams cad kyi/ /zhal gyi dbyibs ni rnam pa bzhi/ /skyes bu che dang lha mo yi/ /khyim bya'i sgo nga til gyi dbyibs/ /mdzes shing lta na sdug pa yi/ /zhal gyi rnam pa gnyis nyid bya/ /yi dwags sha za 'byung po dang / /khro bo rnams kyi rnam 'gyur dbyibs/ /zlum po dag dang gru bzhi ste/

/zhal ni gnyis dag bya ba yin/ /zhes gsungs pas/ zhi zhal sangs rgyas byang sems kyi khyim bya'i sgo nga dang / lha mo rnams kyi til/ khro zhal la/ khro bo spyi'i zlum po ha cang khros pa'i gru bzhi rnams/ zhal gyi gzhi gru bzhir byas pa'i grwa bzhi ka nas cha phran phyed dang gnyis bcad pa dang / stod de dang 'dra ba la/ smad zur gnyis nas cha phran phyed gsum bcad pa dang / gnyis ka nas gnyis gnyis bcad pa dang / gnyis ka nas re re bcad pa 'byung bar bshad kyang / dang po gnyis la logs nas kyang re re bcad dgos la/ zhal bzhi po de 'khor lo bde mchog gi g.yas dang rgyab dang mdun dang g.yon zhal gyi dbyibs su bshad cing / rim pa ltar sangs rgyas byang sems rnams dang / phag mo gzugs can dum skyes ma rnams dang / khro bo rnams dang / mā ma ki dang dpa' bo dpa' mo rnams kyi zhal yang de dag dang 'dra bar bya bar gsungs la/ spyan ni rtsa zhal zlum po zheng du nas bcu dang / dkyus la nas bcu bzhi/ rgyab zhal la zheng nas drug dang dkyus nas bco brgyad ste nya lta bu/ gzhan gnyis la zheng sor gcig dang / dkyus sor gnyis te pad+ma lta bu bya bar bshad/ nas ni sor gyi brgyad cha la bya bar gsungs so/ /spyan rnams ni phal cher khro zhal gyi spyan du snang la/ zhi ba'i spyan ni/ sangs rgyas rnams la bsam gtan gyi gzigs stangs/ zheng nas gnyis dang / dkyus nas nyer gnyis pa gzhu'i rnam pa/ byang sems rnams la nas bzhi dang nyi shu ste ut+pal lta bu/ lha mo rnams la bde mchog gi nub zhal lta bu/ ༈ de ltar zhal phyag rnams ldan lha/ /shin tu zhi dang zhi ma khro/ /khro dang shin tu khros pa bzhi/ /dang po'i cha tshad gtsor byas nas/ /gzhan rnams khyad par cung zad brjod/ /phal cher shugs la rtogs par 'gyur/ /dang po la yang longs sprul gnyis/ /longs sku bzhugs dang bzhengs pa gnyis/ /gnyis ka'i thun mong mchu zheng ni/ /sangs rgyas sor mo brgya nyer lnga/

/zhal re phyed bcas bcu gnyis pa/ zhal bcur mchu zheng mtshungs phyir ro/ /dag pa'i byang sems longs sku dang / /sangs rgyas sprul sku bde gshegs sogs/ /sor phyed bcu po phri ba yi/ /brgya dang nyi shu mchu zheng mnyam/ /sar gnas byang sems longs sku dang / /phag mo spyan sogs gshegs ma dang / /sangs rgyas sprul sku shāka thub sogs/ /zhal dgu sor mo brgya dang brgyad/ /dgu brgyad gnyis ka zhi ma khro/ /khro bo phal cher zhal tshad brgyad/ /sor mo dgu bcu drug par 'dod/ /shin tu khros la zhal lnga dang / /sor mo drug bcu re gnyis sogs/ /zhal tshad gsum pa'ang bshad ces grags/ /rgyal ba'i sprul sku yin na'ang / /khro bo rnams la mtshan dpe yi/ /phyag ring mdzes sogs mi dgos kyi/ /mi sdug bco brgyad la sogs pa/ /gang la gang 'dul nges med yin/ /rgyal ba'i zhal tshad bcu po ni/ /gtsug tor skra mtshams mdzod spu rnams/ /sor bzhi phyed dang lnga dang bzhi/ /shangs rtse mgrin pa dkos ko yang / /de bzhin snying lte gsang gnas rnams/ /zhal re phyed bcas bcu gnyis pa'o/ /brla dang rje ngar zhal do 'o/ /dpyi dang pus mo long bu man/ /bzhi bzhi phyed bcas bzhi pa ste/ /zhabs mthil bcu bzhi 'dir mi bgrang / /de bzhin 'dom la zhal bcu ste/ /dbus nas phrag par zhal gang dang / /bar lhu phyag ngar phyag mgo rnams/ /nyi shu bcu drug zhal gang ste/ /gru mo 'khrig ma gsum gnyis re'o/ /gtsug tor dbus su tshud pa yi/ /thor cog srid la bcu gnyis dang / /dpa' bo sems dpa' brgyad dam dgu/ /thor cog srid la mi rtsi 'o/ /zhal la sogs pa'i zheng tshad ni/ /zhal stod dgu dang zhal skyed bcu/ /zhal smad bdun sogs ci rigs bya/ /snyan zheng gnyis te srid du bzhi/ /snyan zhal bzhi sogs ci mdzes yin/ /spyan dkyus gsum lhag zheng du ni/ /nas gnyis bzhi sogs mdzes par bya/ /smin dkyus bzhi po gzhu lta bu/ /snyan gyi rtse dang thad mnyam ste/

/snyan dbug spyan las cung zad dma'/ /smin phrag phyed dang gnyis su bya/ /mdzod bu sor gcig zlum zhing mdzes/ /spyan dkyus sor gcig bshad pa ni/ /bde mchog khro zhal dbang byas pas/ /smin ma'i phrag dang mnyam pa mdzes/ /spyan ni nag cha sor gcig ste/ /'bras bu sor gyi lnga cha 'o/ /shangs rtse'i zheng ni sor gnyis te/ /mchu dang kos ko'ang de dang mtshungs/ /mchu sgros ma mchu sor gcig dang / /ya mchu sor phyed cher mi rung / /shangs rtse dang ni ya mchu'i bar/ /sor gcig bshad pa'ang bde mchog sogs/ /cung zad zhal gdangs la dgongs pas/ /shin tu zhi la phyed gnyis lhag /kos ko'i dpangs la gnyis bshad la'ang / /de dang 'dra bas cung zad bskyed/ /zhal dkyus sor mo bzhi pa ste/ /grwa gnyis gyen du cung zad stod/ /smin ma'i sbom sar nas gnyis te/ /snyan gyi sgril kha sor phyed bskor/ /rdo gzhong lta bur sor gcig dang / /bu ga sor gcig zlum zhing 'dril/ /mgul zheng sor mo brgyad pa ste/ /snyan 'og mgul gnyer sor mo do/ /de yi phrag pa gong zhal re/ /sku stod sbom sar sum cu 'o/ /dpung lhu'i sbom sar sor drug ste/ /gru mor phyed lnga 'khrig mar ni/ /gsum zer phras pas phye dang bzhi/ /phyag mthil gru bzhi drug zer yang / /srid bdun zheng la lnga par bshad/ /gung mo sor lnga mdzub mo ni/ /de yi sen mo'i rtsa bar sleb/ /ming med de las sor phyed ring / /de gsum skye pa mnyam po ste/ /mthe'u chung de las sor phyed dma'/ /rtse mos ming med gsum gnyis sleb/ /mthe bong skye sa sor gsum dma'/ /mdzub mo'i gsum cha cung mi sleb/ /mthe bong tshigs gnyis mngon pa ste/ /gzhan bzhi sum char mngon pa ste/ /sen mo'i tshigs kyi phyed nas bcal/ /mdzub rtser cung zad ma sleb pa'o/ /byang stod sor mo bco brgyad ste/ /byang smad bcu gnyis sta zur smad/ /bco brgyad byin gyis 'phel ba 'o/

/brla yi zheng tshad sor bcu ste/ /nywa la sor drug byin zhug bzhi/ /zhabs mthil che sar sor drug dang / /chung sar phyed dang bzhi yin te/ /gab pa'i tshul gyis cung zad skyung / /mthe bong sor gsum sboms su gnyis/ /gzhan kun mchu zheng rim gyis skyung / /bzhugs pa rdo rje'i skyil krung la/ /pus mo'i rtse nas rtse yi bar/ /zhal tshad bzhi ru nges pas na/ /zla gdan steng nas mdzod bu dang / /mchu zheng mnyam po yin pa la/ /bod 'ga' skyil krung dpangs dmas par/ /mthong nas skyed par sor bzhi mnan/ /de nas shangs rtse dang mnyam zer/ /pus mo'i dpangs la sor mo bzhi/ /rting pa sor gsum steng du ste/ /rting pa gnyis par sor bzhi lhag /bzhengs pa g.yas brkyangs g.yon bskum dang / /ldog dang sa ga zlum po dang / /rol pa la sogs gang gsungs rnams/ /dang po bzhi po sor mo rnams/ /logs su bstan par khyad par med/ /dang po gnyis po mtho lnga'i 'gyangs/ /bshad kyang zhabs gnyis tshad ldan du/ /btang nas brkyang bskum tshul bzhin du/ /byas pa nyid kyis kun la 'grub/ /sa ga rting pa'i bar sor bzhi/ /brla dang byin pa drang por bsrongs/ /zlum po de dang 'dra ba la/ /pus mo phyi la gdengs pa 'o/ /rol pa g.yon gyi sor mo rnams/ /mdun du drang bstan de'i long bur/ /g.yas pa'i rting pa bkal nas ni/ /sor mo logs su bstan pa nyid/ /g.yas rol zhes bya g.yon rol ldog /mnyam pa sa ga lta bu la/ /bar med mnyam par gcer ba 'o/ /gzhan yang bzhugs stabs mang bshad pa/ /dkyil chog sa chog skabs rnams dang / /rang rang mngon rtogs rnams su blta/ /de rnams zhal tshad bcu pa'i tshad/ /dgu pa la ni zhal ras nyid/ /cung zad bskyed de brgyad po rnams/ /rang sor phyed dang bcu gcig la/ /zhal re'i ming ste mdor nas ni/ /mchu la bcu cha phri ba la/ /zheng la bcu cha kun tu bskyed/ /de bzhin zhal tshad lnga pa la/ /mchu kun phyed la zhal ming ste/

/zheng kun 'dab kyis bskyed pas 'grub/ /'on kyang sbom sar sbom zhing grims/ /phra sar nyag cing 'phrang la 'dril/ /zhib rgyas sdom 'byung 'grel pa sogs/ /gzhan du blta zhing mkhas la bslab/ /gtso bo rgya bod mkhas pa yi/ /phyag rjes nan tan gyis btsal nas/ /bltas shing bcad la lag len gdab/ /slob dpon blun po'i ngag rgyun dang / /rang gi sdug goms ngan goms kyis/ /dad ldan yo byad chud mi zan/ /thub pa chu lon mar grags sogs/ /cha tshad rnams dang mi mthun yang / /mkhas pas byas shing grags che ba/ /kun gyi mthun snang grub pa yi/ /kun la mdzes par snang ba 'ga'/ /shes na'ang mkhas pa'i phyag rjes ltos/ /phyag ni gnyis ka'am gang rung gcig /mnyam bzhag yod na 'gying med bya/ /phyag mang yin na 'gal ba med/ /phyag g.yas gdengs la g.yon pa 'gying / /g.yon gdengs ldog bya zhabs stabs kyang / /gang brkyang phyogs su dbu 'gying yang / /ldog na 'grel ba'i skyon du 'gyur/ /zhal 'gying gang du byas phyogs ni/ /ldog par byang stod 'bur ba dang / /rang sar sta zur 'bur ba gces/ /sum khug drang na mdzes par 'gyur/ /drang srong cha byad skem pa dang / /gzhon nu'i cha lugs gzhon sha rgyas/ /pho rnams stod rgyas smad zhum dang / /mo rnams de las ldog par bya/ /khro bo gar gyi nyams dgu ldan/ /rgyan dang mdangs kyis sgeg pa'i nyams/ /'gying dang rol pas dpa' ba ste/ /spyan ldog khro gnyer mi sdug pa/ /'dzum zhing dgod 'dra bzhad pa'i nyams/ /hūm̐ phaṭa sgrog 'dra drag shul che/ /mtshon cha char gdengs 'jigs su rung / /spyan dmar gzhon sha snying rje'i nyams/ /zhal gdangs rkan sdebs dang 'dra rngams/ /gnyen lcug sha 'jam zhi ba'i nyams/ /dbu skra zhal gang gyen mdzes shing / /ag tshom smin ma'ang gyen brjes 'khyog /mdor na yid la legs shar ba/ /lag tu btab pas nyams kun 'byung / /yid 'phrog bstan pa'i phyi mor 'gyur/ ༈ /da khri rgyab bshad par bya ba la/

dus 'khor rtsa rgyud dum bu las/ khri la khri stan dang / khri gdong dang / khri rkang dang / khri rmang gnyis dang / ba gam dang / lan kan nam/ pu shu ste bdun po byang phyogs sde tshan bdun dang / dag pa sbyar ba tsam dang / rgyab yol la brgyan na drug phar phyin drug dang sbyar te/ bya khyung gi ka ru na ste snying rje dang / chu srin pu ra na ste grong khyer dang / mi chung bh+ya ra na ste tshogs dang / glang chen gu ra na ste bla ma dang / ri dwags sha ra ba ste dbang phyug dang / klu phrug ta ra na ste sgrol mdzad rnams rim pa bzhin du shes rab nas sbyin pa'i bar phar phyin drug lugs ldog dang dag pa sbyar nas gsungs shing / khri la seṅge glang chen rta rma bya shang shang gi 'degs byed dang / nor bu nyi zla dang pad+ma'i gdan rnams ni/ rim pa bzhin/ mi 'jigs pa dang / stobs dang / so so yang dag par rig pa dang / dbang bcu dang / smon gnas shes pa dang / byang chub kyi phyogs dang / don dam e dang / kun rdzob waṃ dang / sgrib pa gsum gyis ma gos pa rnam dag pa dang / tshad med bzhi dang / bsdu dngos bzhi la sogs pa rnams mtshon par byed pa seng rgyan dang dar gyi glo stan la sogs pa gsungs so/ /bod snga ma dag gi khri la brtsegs nyi shu rtsa gcig la sogs pa'i spros pa dang / rgyab yol rgyas pa phub la gzhol btags pa lta bu dang / 'bring po pad 'dab lta bu dang / bsdus pa lcags rtse ma dang sgong gzugs ma la sogs pa'i lag len mang du snang yang 'bring po tsam gyi tshad dang / bzo lugs shes na gzhan rnams shugs la 'byung bas 'di skad ces bya ste/ gdan khri'i 'phang du zhal drug bya/ /sa 'dzin zhal gang de steng du/ /rdo rje'i rgyan phreng sor bzhi'i dpangs/ /nor bu gsum brtsegs sor gnyis te/ /lha snam sor brgyad nor bu gsum/ /phyed dang gnyis re de steng du/ /pad 'dab sor mo drug gi dpangs/ /nor bu nyis brtsegs sor re dang /

/gsum cha re re bre sor bzhi/ /de steng nor bu snga ma tsam/ /glang rgyab sor mo phyed dang bzhi/ /nor bu sor gang bzhi cha'i tshad/ /seng khri sor mo bcu pa ste/ /nor bu snga ma tsam steng du/ /bad chung sor do bzhi cha'i tshad/ /bad chen sor bzhi bzhi gsum ste/ /tsaṇ+ḍa sor do bzhi chas dman/ /steng khebs sor bzhi bzhi cha 'o/ /srid du sa 'dzin zhal bcu gsum/ /lha rnams so sor zhal bcu gcig /seng khri zhal brgyad sor bzhi'i brgya/ /bad chen zhal tshad bcu yin phyir/ /gzhan rnams skyong 'bur shugs las shes/ /'on kyang zhib tu sbyor 'dod na/ /tsaṇ+ḍa bad las sor bzhis gtung / /de bas steng khebs sor do bcag /bad chung bad las sor drug gtung / /de bas nor bu sor dos dman/ /de bas seng khri sor dos bcag /de 'og nor bu sor gsum bsring / /de 'og nor bu steng dang mnyam/ /de bas bre ni sor gang thung / /nor bu gnyis ni 'phang tsam bsring / /pad 'dab rtsa ba sor gang bsring / /'dab ma'i rtse mo sor lnga bsring / /nor bu gnyis dang lha snam dag /sor mo do do phyi la bskyed/ /nor bu gsum po snga ma bzhin/ /rdor phreng sor mo sa 'dzin ni/ /sor mo gsum chas bsring bar bya/ /rgyab yol sku tshad nyis 'gyur dang / /zhal gang tshad kyi tshangs thig gdab/ /'og nas steng du zhal lnga dang / /sor gang tshad kyis rtags byas la/ /de nas steng du'ang de tsam bskyed/ /steng 'og btags nas g.yas g.yon du/ /bya rog rjes rtsal thig gcig btab/ /de la dpung khri'i steng 'byung mod/ /'on kyang mtha' gnyis sor lnga lnga/ /stod nas thig gdab ci mdzes bya/ /tshangs thig dpung thig 'dzoms sa nas/ /steng gi phyogs su zhal do bsnur/ /nor bu ma gtogs sku de yi/ /lta stangs gtsug tor bar tshad kyi/ /srad bus dpung khri'i steng nas bskor/ /rtse mo cung mnan g.yas g.yon du/ /cung zad steng stod ci mdzes bya/ /rgyab yol dpung par sor brgyad tsam/

/bsnan la stod rgyas dbyibs legs bya/ /skor thig sna yi ci ran bya/ /'og tu tshangs thig g.yas g.yon du/ /zhal gcig sor lnga'i tshad tsam gyi/ /sa nas gyen mthur thig re gdab/ /de dag rgyab yol phyi rgya'i tshad/ /stod rgyas smad phyogs cung zad zhum/ /pad 'dab zlum rgyas dbyibs 'dra bya/ /mtha' bskor me ri pa ṭa dang / /rdo rje phreng dang zlum bskor rnams/ /sor mo phyed dang bzhi dang ni/ /sor do dang ni sor brgyad tsam/ /de dag bar bar mu tig phreng / /sor mo phyed phyed mdzes pas brgyan/ /de nas bar skor ldem la rtse/ /bkod legs mdzes shing khyad 'phags bya/ /lugs 'di deng sang mdzes par grags/ /'on kyang phyi dus gdan khri rnams/ /bzhengs pa shin tu nyung bar snang / /shong na shin tu gal che bas/ /gang 'grub nan tan bskyed par bya/ /gsum pa la/ rdor dril ni/ bla ma snga ma rnams phyi dril nang dril gyi tha snyad mdzad pa la/ phyi rabs pa dag nang gi rdor dril ni nges don ye shes la byed dgos pas/ rtags kyi rdor dril la phyi dril gyi khyab bo zhes snga rabs pa la tshig ngan bcas nas smra'o/ /de ni mi 'thad de/ 'o na nang gi gsang sngags nges don ye shes la byed dgos pas/ brjod byed kyi gsang sngags la phyi gsang sngags dang nang gi gsang sngags med par 'gyur la/ de 'dod na gsang sngags phyi nang gi dkyil 'khor zhes sogs rgyud sde 'og ma la phyi dang / bla med la nang du grags shing grub pa dang / yo ga nas bshad cing grags pa'i de nyid bcu la/ phyi'i de nyid dang / bla med nas byung ba'i de nyid bcu la nang gi de nyid du mkhas pa kun la grags shing / rang gi kyang bden zhen gyi khas blangs dang 'gal lo/ /des na rdor dril gyi tha snyad tsam mdo sde 'ga' zhig nas kyang 'byung zhing / bya spyod nas lag len byed mod kyi/ cha tshad sogs kyi mtshan nyid ni/ yo ga dang bla med nas ma gtogs gzhan du mi 'byung la/

yo ga'i bshad rgyud rtse mo nas gsungs pa'i mtshan nyid can la phyi dril dang dus 'khor/ sdom 'byung / sam+pu ṭi la sogs nas bshad pa la nang dril bu tha snyad nges par byed dgos pa yin pas ma dag pas dag pa sun ma 'byin cig 'di gnyis kyi ngos 'dzin la yang / mi shes pa dag rtse dgu dang rtse lnga la phyi nang du byed pa mi 'thad ste/ gnyis ka nas gnyis ka gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /zhi drag kyang de dang 'dra'o/ /de nas de gnyis kyi khyad chos kyi gtso bo ni/ rtse lnga dang rtse dgu gang yin kyang / rwa rnams chu srin gyi kha nas ma thon zhing pad+ma la gnas pa dang / mtha' rwa'i rtse rnams dbus rwa ngos la ma zug par dbus rwa'i mtha' pad+ma dang 'khor lo la sogs pa'i mtshon byed kyis bskor ba la zug cing / rwa rnams ni ba dī ra'i tsher la ltar rno zhing zur dang ldan pa min par/ zlum por gnas pa dang / dril bu'i tshangs mgo'i zhal gyi 'og tu bum pa'i dod du bug pa yod pa dang / rdza mar grags pa'i steng gi pad 'dab kyi shar du/ spyan ma'i sa bon nam phyag mtshan yod pa rnams ni phyi yin la/ de las ldog cing sgrol ma'i sa bon nam/ phyag mtshan yod pa ni nang yin no/ /de ltar phyi nang gnyis las/ 'dir nang gi rdor dril gtso bor bshad par bya ba la/ mtshan nyid dang / dag pa'o/ /dang po la/ dus 'khor las/ za ra rlung me chu sa 'dod lha lha min mi rnams kyi rdo rje'i tshad rim pa bzhin sor gcig pa dang / gnyis pa dang / bzhi pa dang / lnga pa dang / brgyad pa dang / dgu pa/ bcu gnyis pa rnams ni rim pa bzhin spyi bo'i nor bu dang / mthe bo'i rdo rje dang / dpral ba dang / mgrin pa dang / phrag par 'phyang ba'i rgyan dang / snying khar gdags pa'i rgyan dang / lag tu sor ba'i rdo rje rnams kyi tshad du gsungs shing / thams cad kyang lte ba dang phyogs kyi ra rnams gsum cha mnyam du bya la/ khyad par tha ma kha gyes pa khro bo'i dang / zlum po zhi ba'i rdo rje dang /

dril bu la tshangs mgo de gnyis dang / kha sangs pad+ma rgyas pa dang ba lang gi kha'i rnam par gnas pa ni/ de gnyis su bshad do/ /rdo rje'i bar gyi gsum cha yang / gsum cha gsum du byas pa'i bar la lte ba dang / gzhan gnyis la pad 'dab rwa rnams kyi dbus rwa'i bzhi cha mtha' rwa zug mtshams las phyir lhag pa gru bzhi pa/ mtha' rwa'i 'og gi gsum cha chu srin gyi kha nas thon pa phyi la sgyed pa steng gsum gnyis nang du sgur ba/ ba dī ra'i tsher ma ltar gru bzhi rno ba/ dril bu yang de bzhin du gsum cha mnyam du gnas pa/ de yang dus 'khor dgos kyi dbang du byas na/ rdo rje'i lte ba la lha'i zhal bzhi bya ba ni tshad med bzhi dang / dril bu'i tshangs mgo la'ang zhal bzhi bya ba ni rnam thar bzhi rnam par dag pa yin la/ bla med spyi 'gro'i dbang du byas na/ kā li thabs/ ā li shes rab tu grags la/ gsal byed la dbyangs med pa mtshon pas rdo rje la zhal med cing / dbyangs brjod pa dang bcas par mtshon pas dril bu la bcom ldan ma'i zhal gcig go /zhes pa tsam gsungs la/ sgom pa'i rdo rje ni rtse mo gsum pa dang / lnga pa dang / bdun pa dang / sor gcig pa dang / sor gsum pa dang / re lnga pa sogs kyang bshad do/ /sdom 'byung dang sam+pu ṭi la sogs par ni spyi 'gro'i dbang du byas pa/ gzhan 'dra ba la/ rwa dang pad+ma'i bar du zla gdan nam/ 'od kyi phreng ba zhes pa gcig bshad la/ dbus rwa'i rtsa ba zlum po dang sked pa nas ltar sbom pa/ gru bzhi pa/ ri mo gsum yod pa bshad la/ dril bu la sher phyin gyi zhal gyi 'og tu stong nyid kyi rang bzhin gyi bum pa dang / de'i 'og tu bre'i ming can tshangs mgo 'jug sa'i bug pa/ de'i 'og tu pad+ma'i ge sar ri mo gsum/ de nas 'dab mgo mthur du bstan pa'i pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i shar lho nub byang du sgrol ma/ spyan ma/ mā ma ki/ gos dkar mo rnams kyi phyag mtshan ni/ sa bon/ tām̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐/
