me nas g.yas bskor gyi mtshams bzhir nor rgyun ma/ tsun dā/ khro gnyer can/ phreng ba rnams kyi/ bam̐ tsum̐ bh+riṃ mām̐ rnams dang / 'dab ma'i 'og tu phreng ba ste/ 'di la rigs gzhan gyis byed na 'khor lo dang pad+ma sogs kyi phreng ba dang / de la 'phyang ba'i drwa ba drwa phyed/ kha khyer gyi gong du yang rdo rje'i phreng ba bya zhing / nang du lcags kyi dbyi gu zur brgyad pa bya la/ drwa ba drwa phyed kyi khongs su shar la sogs pa'i phyogs bzhir g.yas bskor gyi 'khor lo rin po che/ pad+ma/ ral gri/ me la sogs pa'i mtshams bzhir/ spyan/ rdo rje/ pad+ma/ ut+pal lo/ /dril bu yang sor bcu gnyis pa cha mnyam du bya/ rdo rje sems dpa'i dril bu kha cig sor dgu pa drwa ba drwa phyed med pa tshangs mgo rtse lnga pa dang rtse dgu pa dpa' bo'i dril bur bshad la/ rdo rje rtse dgu pa ye shes kyi rdo rje dang / rtsi lnga pa dam tshig gi rdo rjer/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud nas bshad do/ /rnam dag ni/ dus 'khor nas sor gcig pa nas/ bcu gnyis pa'i bar rnams/ lus kyi nor bu dang / gtsug tor dang / dpral ba dang / mgrin pa dang / snying ga dang / lte ba dang / gsang gnas kyi rtsa 'khor gyi tshad dang rnam dag sbyar ba tsam las ma gsungs la/ sam+pu ṭir/ phyogs gcig gi rwa lnga ni rnam snang dbus su byas pa'i rigs lnga/ rwa gzhan lnga ni/ dbus ye shes/ shar rdo rje/ byang 'jigs byed/ nub ro langs/ lho gtum mo ste/ gdan bzhir gsungs pa'i khro mo'am/ gshegs ma lnga/ pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad cha gnyis kyi rigs lnga phyogs ni/ spyan ras gzigs/ byams pa/ mkha' snying / kun bzang / phyag rdor/ 'jam dpal/ sgrib sel/ sa snying rnams shar nas g.yas bskor ram/ bla ma gong ma rnams gsang 'dus 'phags lugs kyi sems dpa' brgyad ltar bkod/ yum lnga phyogs ni/ phyogs bzhi lcags kyu/ zhags pa/ lcags sgrog dril bu ma/ mtshams bzhir/ tsun dā/ rin chen sgrol ma/

lu gu brgyud ma/ gzhan gyi mi thub ma rnams su bsgom zhing / ye shes pa bcug nas mchod de zhu ba las byung bar blta zhing mos pa lha'i rnam dag dang / bde stong dbyer med kyi ngo bor mos pa bden pa gnyis ka'i dang / stong nyid 'od gsal rkyang par mos pa don dam gyi dang / lam lnga dang 'bras bu thams cad kyi rang bzhin du mos pa kun rdzob kyi rnam dag rnams bshad la/ dril bu la sa bon ni/ phyag mtshan sbyar ba'i lha'i dang / rdza ma 'dod khams/ steng gi pad 'dab sa bon dang bcas pa gzugs khams/ bum pa shes rab kyi zhal la sogs pa gzugs med de khams kyi rnam dag dang / khong stong phyag rgya'i pad+ma/ lce zur brgyad pa thabs kyi rdo rje ste des pad+ma'i nang gi rtsa brgyad bskyod pas bde chen 'byung ba ltar/ lce zur brgyad pas nang gi phyogs mtshams brgyad du bskyod nas dkrol ba ni dril bu gnas brgyad du dkrol ba'i don du man ngag snye mar bshad la/ kṛ ya sa muts+tshar/ lte ba de nas snying ka mgrin/ /kha dang sna yi bu ga gnyis/ /rna ba dag dang mig dag dang / /de bzhin spyi bor dril bu dkrol/ /zhes kyang bshad do/ /der rdor dril thig sgrom gyi khog nas 'don lugs sogs rgyas par bshad pa ni/ spro zhing nus na der blta'o/ /tshangs mgo dang rdo rje rtse dgu pa ni/ phyogs gnyis ka rigs lnga yab yum bzhi'am/ bha wa bha tras dbus rwa rnams snang / phyogs gcig gi ra sems dpa' brgyad/ phyogs gcig gi rwa sems ma brgyad du bshad mod kyi/ pad 'dab brgyad la dag pa mi sbyor na ma gtogs bzlos par 'gyur ro/ /rwa rnams chu srin gyi kha nas ma thon pa ni/ snying rjes sems can mi gtong ba'o/ /kṛ yar ḍā ma ru dang rtse gsum dgra satwa ral gri sogs kyi tshad rgyas par bshad pa'ang spro na der blta la/ phyag mtshan gang dang gang gi mgo bo 'dzin mkhan de'i mtho re dang / yu ba can gyi yu ba rnams khru gang las mi thung ba yu ba'i mthar rdo rjes mtshan pa/

༈ ral gri srid sor drug cu pa dang / zheng du sor bzhi pa/ yu ba'i mtshan nyid rgyas pa sogs gsungs mod kyi/ phal cher sgrub pa sla la/ ༈ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga ni/ rtse mor rdo rje rtse lnga rdzogs pa/ de'i 'og tu mi mgo skam po gsum brtsegs dang / de'i 'og tu sna tshogs rdo rje dang / yu ba'i rtse mor rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i mtshan pa lugs gcig dang / yang na rtse mor sna tshogs rdo rje/ de nas mi mgo skam po gcig de nas rlon pa gnyis/ de nas rdo rje rtse rdzogs pa la ba dan gsum pa 'phyar ba/ de nas bum pa bzang po shing los kha brgyan pa yu ba dang bcas pa'i lugs gcig dang / gnyis ka'ang yu ba'i stod sbom zhing smad 'phra ba dril chung dang bcas pa dgos pa der bshad la/ gzhung gzhan du lugs snga ma bzhin las/ mi mgo skam red rlon pa gsum gyi 'og tu sna tshogs rdo rje/ de nas bum pa yu ba dang bcas pa'ang bshad do/ /bum pa la/ zhi rgyas kyi ni lto ba'i sboms su sor bcu drug zhabs nas kha'i bar gyi dpangs sor nyi shu las/ mgrin pa sor drug kha'i rgyab sor brgyad kyi dbus su gsum cha bug pa/ mthar mchu sor gnyis 'phyang ba yin la/ ༈ bsad bskrad la/ sbom por bcu gnyis/ dpangs su nyer bzhi las mgrin pa sor brgyad yon po kha sor drug mchu sor gcig ༈ dbang dgug la/ bzo bo mkhas pas ji ltar byas pa/ ༈ rengs pa la/ rgya dpangs mnyam pa bcu drug pa/ mgrin pa sor bzhi/ kha sor drug mchu sbor zhing sor gnyis pa ste/ thams cad la rtsa ba med par gsungs pas lhung gzed kyi gsham lta bu/ bod la grags pa'i mchu med pa yin mod kyi/ kha nas chu sbyin pa mi bde bas/ mchu byas par snang ba 'gal ba med do/ ༈ /bzhi pa la bri bya ni/ gro kha'am shing shun nam shog bu dkar po'am tshos ma rang rang gi mdangs gsal ba/ ༈ tshad ni/ rgyud gong ma 'ga' zhig las/ skra dang mchan du sba bar gsungs pas/ sor bcu gnyis pa'am/ bcu drug pa'ang gsungs mod kyi/

brgyad stong pa'i mjug tu glegs bam shin tu chen po la yi ge gsal bar bri bar gsungs pa sogs kyang yod pas 'byor skabs dang bstun la/ rgya dpe la bug pa gcig pa dang gnyis pa gnyis gsungs pa'i dang po cha lngar byas pa'i lnga gsum lnga gnyis kyi mtshams su dang / gnyis pa la cha gsum du bgos nas bu ga gtod pa'i thad skor gru bzhi'am/ zlum po rgya ha cang che chung min pa mdzes pa'o/ /bod na'ang spyan skor du grags pa'ang gsung rab chen po la rung ngo / ༈ /yi ge ni/ rgya gar na tshangs pa'i yi ge la sogs pa yig rigs drug cu rtsa bzhi yod pa rnams las/ bod kyi mkhas pa mthon mi sam+bho ṭas/ kha che'i yi ge dper byas nas/ bod kyi yi ge ma sum cu/ bu drug dang bcas pa mdzad pa las/ rim gyis brgyud de khyung po g.yu khri dang / gsum pa gnod sbyin sogs kyis dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pa/ zab chen dang zab chung / 'bru chen dang 'bru chung / 'bru chen la li lugs dang 'dan lugs/ gshar ma dang dkyus yig la sogs pa'i nang nas/ gsung rab chen po dag ni zab chen dang zab chung dang / rgya gar mkhas pa'i gzhung 'grel rnams ni 'bru chen sogs dang / bod kyi gzhung lugs rnams 'bru chung sogs su bri bar bya la/ yi ge'i mtshan nyid cha tshad brda' dag sogs ni spro bar nus mod kyi ha cang mang bar 'gyur bas ma spros so/ /snag tsha yang rab gser dngul la btso chen dang / btso chung sogs sbyang 'dul la legs par sbyangs pa/ tha ma snag tsha dngos kyang rung ste mdangs gsal ba dang / dam ran pa dang / spyin sha chod pa/ lag cha smyu gu dang smyu gri bdar la sogs pa thams cad tshad gcig la khel ba/ sla bcos su ma song ba sngon du legs par sbyangs shing bslabs te bri bar bya ba yin no/ /de bzhin du khang bzang dang rta babs dang khang brtsegs dang de dag tu dgos pa'i shing gi mtshan nyid dang so bag gi mtshan nyid dang / sgo gzhug pa dang / ka ba zugs pa dang /

rgya phigs ji ltar bya ba'i tshul la sogs pa yang kṛ ya sa muts+tshar rgyas par gsungs pa shes par bya la/ gtsug lag khang che chung gang byed pa la cher gyi brgyad cha'am/ bcu cha sgo'i zheng dang / de'i nyis 'gyur srid dang / sgo'i bcu cha ru bzhi la bya ba sogs kyang skabs dang sbyar la/ thog 'bubs kyi shing brtsegs la sogs pa'ang dgos mod kyi/ rgyas par byas na yi ge mang la/ rags rim ni bzo bo phal cher gyis shes shing / gnas mal gyi gzhi la sogs pa nas bshad pas 'bubs tshul ni/ da lta sgrub pa yang dka' bas 'dir ma spros so/ ༈ /lnga pa ji ltar bzhengs pa'i cho ga la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po la sa chog dang / sta gon no/ /dang po la brtag pa dang / slang ba dang / sbyang ba dang / bzung ba dang / bgegs bzlog pa rnams phal cher dkyil chog rnams su ji ltar bshad pa bzhin bya/ khyad par 'ga' zhig 'dir yang brjod na/ dge 'dun gyi sde dang rten gsum sogs bzhengs pa'i sa 'am/ yo byad 'tshol tu chas pa'i tshe phyi'i bltas dang / ༈ sa bon 'debs dang ljon shing 'jug /rta dang phyugs lugs 'ded pa dang / /khur bzang khyer nas 'ongs dang 'phrad/ /phyogs der longs spyod 'phel bar 'gyur/ /lha gsol mkhar rtsig bag ma len/ /khye 'u mang po brtse ba dang / /bkra shis rab gnas bya ba dang / /bzhad gad dang 'phrad bde bskyed 'byung / /dkon mchog gsum dang chos sgrog dang / /kha ton bsam gtan sgom pa dang / /ngur smrig gyon pa sogs mthong na/ /slob dang 'chad nyan 'phel bar 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor ldan pas de dus dang / /de yis gleng mo byed dus kyi/ /rlung gi bltas la khyad par brtag /gzhan yang bya dang khyi sogs kyi/ /skad dang kha yi blta phyogs sogs/ /dus sbyor chen mor bshad rnams brtag /bltas mtshan bzang na myur du brtsams/ /ngu dang snod stong khyer la sogs/ /ngan pa byung na phyi la mnur/ /yang yang ngan na rim gro dang / /gzhan du spo ba la sogs bya/

/gza' skar dus sbyor la sogs rtsam/ /byed pa'am sa rdo sko ba'i sar/ /rdo legs byang ngam shar ram steng / /kha bltas mthong na dge bar bshad/ /rdo ngan phyogs gzhan bltas na ngan/ /sa brkos pa yi kha dog sogs/ /zug rngu rnams kyi brtag tshul dang / /gang du dang po bsko ba'i tshe/ /lto 'phye brtag tshul la sogs pa/ /kho bos dus 'khor 'jam rdor sogs/ /dkyil chog mang por bshad la bltos/ /lto 'phye brtag tshul mdor bsdu na/ /ston zla gsum la mgo bo shar/ /de bzhin g.yas bskor byed pas na/ /ji tsam 'os pa'i zlum thig la/ /phyogs rer gsum gsum tshad pa yis/ /dum bu bcu gnyis snyoms par bya/ /re re'ang gsum gsum bgos pa rnams/ /zhag bcu'i gnas yin rags rtsis ni/ /de tsam gyis rtogs rgyas par ni/ /de yang bcu bcur mtshan ma rnams/ /zlum thig nyid las bgos byas la/ /srid tshad mtha' nas mthar sleb cing / /zheng tshad bcu cha'i tshad ltar bgyis/ /shing ngam shog bu la sogs kyi/ /lte bar drang por gzer nas ni/ /ston zla ra ba'i tshes gcig la/ /stod mdun byang shar ri mo dang / /smad rgyab lho nub ri mo la/ /reg par byas la bzhag re bzhin/ /stod kyi mdun la g.yas su bskor/ /dus tshes gang yin de nyid du/ /gnas pa'i mdun du ri mo lnga/ /phyed bcas nang gi rko sa der/ /srid la bcu char byas pa yi/ /stod la gsum dang smad du drug /bor bas bcu cha de nyid yin/ /ri'u mig mang po dgos pa chung / /rko sa'i dmigs nas rko ba ni/ /chos don 'dod pa dngos grub 'byung / /yon tan thams cad 'phel bar gsungs/ /mgo bor brkos na nye du 'chi/ /rgyab tu rang nyams gnas nor bskrod/ /mjug ma rta glang phyugs rnams dang / /'bangs dang stobs ni nyams par 'gyur/ /kham lnga brkos par shing grog sbur/ /skra sen thal bas 'tshe bar 'byung / /rdo las rlung gis 'jigs pa dang / /rus pas nad 'byung 'gal dum gyis/

/sna tshogs rims rnams 'byung bar bshad/ /de bzhin du dkyil chog rnams nas bshad pa'i kha dog dri ros brtag pa sogs kyi sas brtag pa dang / chus brtag pa yang byas la sa gzhi 'dom gru bzhi/ ba byung dang bdud rtsi la sogs pa byugs pas/ slob dpon rang nyid khrus byas nas chas gos gtsug tor sogs dang ldan pas yi dam gang yang rung ba'i bdag bskyed bzlas pa mchod gtor dang bcas pa bya zhing / chos skyong dang zhing skyong la gtor ma byin nas/ gsang 'dus 'jam rdor du bshad pa'i/ khams gsum gnas pas lha rnams dang / /zhes sogs nas/ de ltar bdag gis khyod la ni/ /mchod cing gsol gyis ma bslu bar/ /rmi lam la sogs mtshan ma dang / /legs nyes ltas rnams bstan du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum dang / oṃ mu tsi li swā hā/ oṃ mo ha ni swā hā/ oṃ dan+ti li swā hā/ zhes pa rmi lam brtag pa'i sngags 'di lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas te kha la bsngags na/ 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gi mdun pas mchod pa sngon du 'gro bas/ mgo lho dang kha shar du phyogs pa gos gtsang ma gyon te nyal nas rmi lam brtag cing / ngan na bzlog pa bya ste bskyar zhing / bzang na mngon pa dang mi mngon pa la blang ba dang / gnang ba gsol ba dang / sbyin sreg zhi drag dang / rdzas sngags lta ba dang / stong pas sbyang ba dang / sa bzung ba la sogs pa dkyil chog ji bzhin bya la/ dkyil 'khor bri ba 'tshal zhes pa'i gnas su/ lha khang ngam/ mchod rten nam/ rten gsum bzhengs par 'tshal/ zhes sogs skabs dang sbyar ba'i 'don pa spo bar bya'o/ /sta gon la'ang / sa dang lha dang bum pa/ sta gon gyi dkyil chog bzhin du byas te/ lha la 'don pa spo ba'i gsol ba btab nas/ nam mkhar bzhugs su gsol bar bya'o/ /khyad par du bzo bo dang rgyu cha sta gon nam/ rang gtso bo'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ bzo bo dang rgyu cha rags rim gang bsogs dang lag cha rnams bsags pa'i mdun du mchod gtor bshams/

bsang sbyangs byin gyis brlabs/ bzo bo sogs kyang las sngags dang bgegs mthar byed kyi phreng sngags dang bdud bgegs bsreg pa'i sngags la sogs pa dang / las bum gyi chus bgegs bsangs/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bzhengs par bya ba'i lha de'am/ rnam snang ngam/ bgegs mthar byed du cho ga gsum gyis bskyed/ dbang bskur thob pa yin na de rang yang bsgom du gzhug cing / grub na dbang yang bskur/ rgyu dang lag cha rnams kyang bsang sbyang byas nas/ stong pa'i ngang las rnam snang du bskyed/ ras bris kyi thig tshon gyi dkyil chog bzhin du bskyed pa rnams la/ rigs gsum mam/ lnga'am/ drug gi sa bon la sogs pa rnams la spyi bo la sogs par bkod/ ye shes pa yang dang yang du bcug dbang lha spyan drangs te dbang bskur/ mchod cing bstod/ na mo bha ga wa te shākya mu na ye ta thā ga ta ya ar+ha te saṃmyag saṃ bhū dha ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ mu ne mu ne ma hā mu ne ya swā hā/ zhes dang / oṃ na mo bha ga wa te bai ro tsa nā ya pra bha rā dza ya/ ta thā ga ta ya ar+ha te/ saṃmyag saṃ bud+dhā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ suk+ṣ+me suk+ṣ+me/ sa me sa ma ya/ shan+ti dan+te/ sa mā ro s+ya/ a na laṃ bhe/ ta ra be/ nir ku le nir wa ne/ ya sho wa te/ ma hā te dze/ sarba bud+dha dhiṣ+ṭha na dhiṣ+ṭhi te swā hā/ zhes dang / rten 'brel snying po bdun la sogs pa bzlas te byin gyis rlabs/ lha rnams zhu ba las byung ba'i rgyu cha rin po che'i phung po dang / lag cha rang rang gi gzugs su bsgyur/ me tog gtor zhing shis pa brjod pa rgyas par bya'o/ /phreng ba sogs su yig mkhan 'od dpag med du bskyed pa dang / smyu gu dang snag tsha byin brlab bshad pa ni dngos gzhi yig mgo 'dzugs pa'i dus su byed pa yin no/ /rnying pa gso ba'i mchod rten la/ ar+gha'i cho gar grags pa ni/ chen po chung ngu gtong ba sogs ni gtan mi rung la/ rgyu dang tshad bzang du gtong ba'am/

gnas 'o rgyal ba nas mi rgyal sar spo ba byed pa ni/ rgyud dang mkhas pa'i gzhung las gnang ba rig pas kyang 'thob la/ 'chos rgyu'i rten gyi drung du mchod pa gang 'byor bshams/ bdag bskyed gang 'grub bzlas pa dang bcas pa'ang byas te/ lha la mchod bstod rgyas par byas nas/ lha sta gon nam/ rab gnas kyi snyan gsan gyi tshigs bcad la/ khyed kyi dkyil 'khor bri ba 'am/ /rab gnas bgyid par 'tshal gyi gnas su/ khyed kyi rten ni mchod par 'tshal/ /zhes pas 'don pa spo ba'i gsol ba lan gsum gdab/ phyogs skyong la'ang gtor ma byin/ legs nyes ltas rnams bstan du gsol/ /gyi bar lan gsum dang / rmi lam brtag pa yang snga ma bzhin byas la/ rung bar shes na/ skabs su bab pa'i tshe cho ga snga ma la sang ni bgyid par 'tshal gyi gnas su da lta bgyid par 'tshal bcug pas gsol gdab lan gsum gyi bar du byas nas/ rgyud sde 'og ma nas me long la gzugs brnyan 'char du bcug ste/ ye shes pa dang dam tshig pa mtha' dag me long gi nang du bzhugs par mos pa brtan po bya/ dar dmar pos zhal bkab/ rgyab tu rgya byas/ mgo mjug mi log pa'i mtshan ma byas nas mchod gral du bzhugs pa la mchod pa rtag tu 'bul bar bshad cing / kṛ ya sa muts+tshar rdo rje'am/ phreng ba'am/ srad bu kha dog lnga pas bcings pa la bzhugs pa'am/ yang na bum pa rgyan dang mtshan mas brgyan pa'i nang du bzhugs pa la mchod pa 'bul bar bshad/ dus 'khor rgyud du rang gi lag pa'i rdo rje la bzhugs par yang gsungs mod kyi/ slob dpon rang nyid kyi snying kha'i sa bon la bzhugs pa ni/ bla med kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i chos yin pas/ de rnams gang yang rung ba ji ltar mos pa byas la/ gtsug khang dang mchod rten ni rnam snang du bskyed nas sngar bzhin bya'o/ /de nas rgyu cha rnying pa rnams bshig ste/ gsar pa la gang 'dre bsre ba dang / mi 'dre ba'am/ bskyed pa'i mi thub pa sogs yin na/

ri'i phug gam chu chen po sogs la dor ste/ rnying pa'i rjes mi mngon par byas la/ gsar pa sgrub tshul bshad zin dang 'chad 'gyur ltar bya'o/ /dngos gzhi la sngar med gsar du sgrub pa dang / grub zin gyi skyon bsal ba'o/ /dang po ni/ gtsug lag khang ngam mchod rten dang khang bzang sogs la 'og gzhir bum gter gzhug par gsungs pas 'byor na rin po che'am/ ma 'byor na rdza bum gsar pa mchu lung med pa bre gang yan chad shong ba lnga byi dor byas pa'i nang du 'bru/ sman/ dri/ rin po che/ snying po rnams lnga lnga/ zas sna dar zab la sogs pa dang / rigs brgyud ma nyams pa'i btsan po'i pho brang / phyug gi khang pa'am bang mdzod/ gnas gzhi'i sgo khang / grong khyer gyi dbus/ bod kyi zhing / 'brog gi lhas bzang po rnams kyi sa sna/ rdo sna/ rdo'i sgrom bu bya ba'i phyir du g.yam leb bzang po la/ 'og tu 'ding rgyu'i pad+ma dang / steng du 'gebs rgyu'i 'khor lo dang / logs su bskor rgyu'i bkra shis rtags brgyad legs par bris pa rnams bshams/ dge 'dun gyi bsnyen bkur dang / bzo bo la ltad mo la ston mo la sogs pa yang tshags su tshug par byas/ rigs dang gzugs dang lang tsho dang dpal 'byor dang ldan pa'i khyi'u 'am/ bu mo gzhon nu bzhi dang / de dag gi lag tu gzung bar bya ba'i snod bzang por bcud nyer lnga dpal bshos la sogs pa yang mi 'thogs par bya ste/ gza' skar dang sbyor byed bzang po'i snga dro'i char dus sbyor bzang ba la/ slob dpon rang gis sngags dang bstun nas/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi chas gos bzang po rdor dril dang ldan pa'am/ 'dul ba ltar na chos gos rnam gsum legs par bgos dbu reg zhabs rjen/ dge 'dun tsam yod kyang de bzhin du byas/ bzo bo dang las byed pa dang khye'u sogs kyang rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan/ bza' btung bzang po bzos zin pa'i mjug tu/ gang du byed pa'i gnas der phyin te me tog 'thor/

ye dharmā dang bkra shis brjod cing / phyogs der ji tsam mtshams par g.yas bskor du bcags/ shes na nag rtsis kyi phyogs brtag pa dang / dkar rtsis kyi sgra gcan gdong mjug sogs la 'gram 'tshol ba po'i gdong ma thug par bya zhing / mi shes na phyogs thams cad rang bzhin med par mos shing / byang dang shar gang rung du kha blta bar bshad pa bzhin du byas/ 'dir yang lto 'phye brtags nas dbang ldan gyi zur nas g.yas bskor gyi 'gram 'bru zhing / las mi yang las thams cad par bskyed pa sogs byas nas bya'o/ /'gram legs par rnyed pa na/ khye'u 'am bu mo bzhi pos lag pa g.yon du snod bzang po bcud kyis bkang ba dang dpal bshos la sogs pa bzung zhing / g.yas pas srad bu bzung ste/ zur bzhir 'then du bcug nas/ phyogs cung zad kyang ma 'chugs par byas nas zur bzhi por phur bu gdab la/ srad bu brgyangs te thig skud las ma 'chugs par 'gram gzhug go /phyogs 'tshol ba na/ phal cher smin drug 'char sa la shar du byed na'ang / smin drug ni byang shar nas nub byang du nub par mngon sum gyis grub pas/ khang pa phal cher byang shar du 'chus pa mang bar snang ba ni skyon yin pas/ smin drug nam mkha'i dbus su sleb dus kyi nar stabs ma 'chugs pa'am/ yang na ston dpyid nyin mtshan mnyam pa'i nyi ma 'char ba dang nub pa la shar nub drang thad du bya zhing / sa cha dang lung pa'i stabs kyi byar med na/ gtsug lag khang lta bu'i nar stabs dgos pa/ dgos kyi lung pa'i 'phrad gcod du yong zhing / sa phyogs de nyid kyi mdun la mdun yong bar bya'o/ /de'i tshe/ phyogs bzhi'i ri bzang dpyad dang ldan pa bzhi nas/ rdo legs tshad dang ldan pa re re skyes bu bzang ltas tshang ba re len du btang la/ zur bzhir bzhag par bya zhing / gser dngul la sogs pa'i rin po che gang 'byor yang der gzhug par bshad do/ /bum gter yang 'gram gyi phyogs bzhi dang dbus su sa brus par rdo rje'i sgrom bu legs par byas te bzhag

phyogs skyong gzhi bdag la gtor ma byin/ gter chen po'i bum par bsgom nas/ khyed dkar phyogs la mngon par dga' ba dang / khyad par gnas gzhi'am/ gtsug lag khang ngam/ mchod rten 'di bsrung ba'i srung ma thams cad longs spyod zad mi shes pa'i gter la spyod par gyur cig phyogs 'dir gnas pa'i skye bo thams cad la yang dgos 'dod zad med du 'byung ba'i rogs mdzod cig ces sogs kyi 'phrin las bcol zhing shis brjod bya/ yid kyis gzhi der gang 'dod pa'i gtsug lag khang la sogs pa de nyid sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes las grub pa bzang zhing gya nom legs par grub zin pa la/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis byin gyis rlabs cing rgyun du shis brjod mdzad pa dang / lha dang chos skyong thams cad kyis sgrub grogs dang bsrung skyob la g.yel ba med pa dang / lha mi thams cad kyis nyin mtshan kun tu mchod pa 'bul ba dang / de thams cad srung 'khor thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i nang du tshud pas/ bdud bgegs nag po la dga' ba gang gis kyang mi mthong bar mos shing sa chog gi skabs su phur gdab byas pa'i phur bu bsrung ba'i khro bo dang chos skyong phyogs skyong la gtor ma byin pa sogs byas pas bgegs med cing 'grub che bar 'gyur ro/ /lha khang la sogs pa shin tu rgya khyon dang ldan pa byed na/ gling bzhi gling phran/ gser gyi ri bdun ri rab dang bcas pa'i bkod pa'am/ rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang la grong khyer lta na sdug tshal gyi bskor ba'am/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i bkod pa'am/ gnas mal gyi gzhi nas 'byung ba ltar/ dri gtsang dang / khyams dang / sgo khang dang / glo 'bur la sogs pa'i bkod pa'am/ chung ngu la ji ltar 'tshams pa'i dpyad dang bkod pa mdzes pa/ phyi nang gi sa dgra med pa mkhas pa yid 'phrog cing mthong dgu dang ba 'dren pa/ snod mi 'jig pa'i bar du 'jig mi srid pa tsam gyi brtan cing bsra ba/

thog gi shing brtsegs la sogs pa yang 'byor pa dang bstun pas gang shom dang gang mdzes mthangs gsal zhing sa rdul chung ba la sogs pa sgo du ma nas legs par 'bad de/ rang gzhan gyi lus dang longs spyod don yod par bya'o/ /mchod rten dang lha sku lha khang glegs bam la sogs pa sgrub tshul cha tshad dang sbyar te gong du brjod pa bzhin no/ /bzo bo rnams rgyan gos bzang po gyon/ gso sbyong la gnas pa'i lag tu byin gyis brlabs pa'i lag cha rnams gtad/ khyad par yig mkhan skad cig gis 'od dpag med du bskyed/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa hūm̐ gis smyu gu dang / oṃ āḥbig+nan ta kṛta hūm̐ gis snag tsha'i snod la lan nyer gcig re mngags te/ rdo rje dang chos 'byung du mos pas lag pa g.yas dang g.yon du gtad la/ oṃ dhīḥshru tri smṛ ti bi dza ye sarba ā dz+nyā na pa ṭa la a pa ha ri ṇi hri swā hā/ zhes bzlas shing / shes rab dang ye shes sbyar te 'od zer rnam par 'phro bas gang bris pa de rnams des yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /zhes mos par bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ dgon gnas grong khyer la sogs la/ /sa'i dgras skyon bskyed bcos par bya/ /gshin rje'i kha dang srin po'i gdong / /brag dmar spre 'u khros 'dra dang / /mtshon cha'i zur gtad logs zur nor/ /brag ri mi gnyis shibs 'dra dang / /sngon po ber khrab gyon 'dra rnams/ /rme dang gri 'dzings dmar ngo yin/ /brag phug dmar po kha bltas na/ /glo bur nad 'byung nor la gzan/ /nag po 'phongs 'dras glen lkugs yong / /gcan gzan gdong sogs mi mdzes pas/ /don med rkyen ngan sna tshogs 'byung / /kun la mchod rten mdzes 'dra ba'i/ /ri las srubs med rdo blangs te/ /gser ram dngul gyi rin po che/ /'bar dang gtsug gi nor bu'i sngags/ /bris nas der gnas thams cad thub/ /mi gnyis gshags 'gyed 'dra ba dang / /seṅge bya khyi 'thab 'dra na/ /de dag rdo la snga ma bzhin/

/sa bo stod smad ral dang 'khyoms/ /grags ngan 'byung phyir rdza las ni/ /rin chen sgrom byas shing thog dang / /'gron bu dung dang rin po che/ /sman dang 'brus bkang rin po che'i/ /gter du byin rlabs sbas pas thub/ /sbrul nag mthur rgyug nya sbal dang / /sdig pa'am chu srin kha gdangs 'dra/ /glo lcong smu chu mdze nad 'byung / /sa lcags rdo la bya khyung gzugs/ /mtho gang lhag byas bstan pas thub/ /rnga mo'i gdong dang ru sbal mgo /bya gcan sder mos brad 'dra na/ /yan lag skyog dang gzhon dar 'chi/ /chu ser nad 'byung mi mi chags/ /rdo 'am rdza la seng ge'i gzugs/ /byas te der kha bstan pas thub/ /ri sna sems can gzugs 'dra dang / /khyi tshugs bsgyid chom re sna zug /skyes pa gri dang byes su 'chi/ /mi nor gnyis ka med par 'gyur/ /rdo 'am rdza la seng ge'i gzugs/ /bzhi byas phyogs bzhir kha bstan cing / /zur bzhir gdugs dkar rgyan mtshan 'dzugs/ /dur khrod chu 'gram sdig pa'i rwa/ /bkrag nyams sa mdog skya la lod/ /bsod nams longs spyod dbang thang chung / /zas nor dgra mang tshig mi btsan/ /sha ba yu thod dngul chu dang / /rin chen 'bru snas bkang la sba/ /rdza yi kong bu phul re la/ /dgu ru sman sna bag phye dang / /bsres pa'i ril bu ba dmar gyis/ /'o mas btsos pas kong bu bkang / /rin chen gter du byin rlabs nas/ /dbus dang phyogs mtshams brgyad sbas thub/ /srin mo'i 'doms dang mo mtshan 'dras/ /tshul 'chal 'khrig pa la sred 'gyur/ /rdo yi dbang phyug sten bcas la/ /tshogs bdag gzugs bris bstan pas thub/ /ri yon thal mdog mya ngan byed/ /rgan mo nyal 'dras mi phyugs nyams/ /rdza yi ga 'ur dri med gzungs/ /rten 'brel snying po gur kum gyis/ /bris gzhug rgyal mtshan rtse mor btags/ /mtshon cha'i rtse dang hom khung gzugs/ /gcan gzan mche gtsigs bya mchu 'dras/ /gri dme gzhon dar 'chi nad ring /

/mtsho nang blangs pa'i rdo leb la/ /gser dngul rdo rje rgya gram bris/ /shar sogs phyogs bzhir mchod rten dang / /me 'bar ri dang rkang gcig shing / /mtsho rnams yod na skyon 'byung zhing / /rgyal blon mi chen grar ldang bas/ /shar du shel gyi mchod rten dang / /lho ru bum pa chus bkang bzhag /nub tu mi bsad mtshon cha zugs/ /byang du rin chen bzhi yi sa/ /blangs te mtsho der blug pas thub/ /steng ngam 'og tu rgya gram lam/ /brag dang chu 'thab pa yi sna/ /sbrul lce 'dra na god che zhing / /mi 'thor ngag gtsug gza' zla 'gras/ /phur pa'i mchod rten phyogs mtshams btsig /bkra shis ri las rdo blangs la/ /gser dngul bkra shis rtags brgyad bris/ /grong khyer bshig 'dra zangs gog gzhom/ /rgan po bya ra byed 'dra dang / /rgan mo ngu 'dra tshig mi btsan/ /brjid chung nor rdzas mi 'du bas/ /rdza gsar gser dngul zangs lcags bsres/ /rin chen 'bar ba'i gzugs byas nang / /ston pa'i ring bsrel sman bcas gzhug /mkhar ram dbu rtse'i rtser btsugs thub/ /stag skya kha gdangs zor gzhu 'dras/ /longs spyod sgrub dka' rtsod mang zhing / /tha mar myur du 'jigs 'gyur bas/ /glang chen sha can rta rus la/ /stobs po che'i gzugs bris nas/ /phyogs bzhir gdab cing rtsa brgyad bya/ /sā ts+tshas bskor bas sa dgra 'joms/ /gzugs dang yi ge la sogs kun/ /rab gnas byas nas phyogs der bstan/ /sa dgra'i rdo blangs 'gram 'og tu/ /sbas na ngan dpyad mtha' dag thub/ /sa sgo gnam sgo ri bye dang / /gong nyag ri gdong thag ring gi /lu chu'i rgyang mda' shar gyi brag /mchod rten 'dra la sā ts+tsha dang / /gab rtse bkra shis kyis bkang ba'i/ /rigs gsum rigs lnga'i rtsa brgyad bya/ /ri bye'i steng du sā ts+tsha 'am/ /khang steng rdo bzang bzhag pas thub/ /gangs zer mthong sar me dpung bri/ /pha wam pho rang sa 'og gzhug /yang na de steng mchod rten bya/

/nub byang stag skya rgyu srang bcad/ /yang na shing gi khram gnyer bstan/ /lho byang 'brug sngon zam pa bya/ /lho yi rus sbal dbyung ngam sgrib/ /byang gi bya dmar brag gis mnan/ /shing skam gang na 'dug kyang bcad/ /khyung glang 'dra la seng ge bstan/ /seng ge 'dra la mchod rten bstan/ /chu rgyun sa yis bsrubs pa dbye/ /lam la khram gnyer mang du bya/ /sa grum phug dang sa dong sub/ /gong gi lam chen grog po yang / /mgo zlum ri la rtse mo gdags/ /yid du mi 'ong gang mthong sgrib/ /phyi yi sa dgra de ltar bcos/ /nang gi bcos thabs bshad kyis nyon/ /ka ba mthong kha gru gsum la/ /ka mthongs ngos la gru gsum bri/ /ka brgyad g.yu rung ris re bri/ /nyi ma phyed 'grib me shel bzhag /gang 'og gdung gi mtho dman la/ /stag pa shing la pho gzugs dang / /glang mar mo bris gong 'og brlan/ /rgya gram gdung gi steng 'og la/ /'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pad+ma bri/ /ro mthon gdung la gro ga la/ /rus sbal lkog sngags bris la sbyar/ /de rnams ma bcos skyon mthun par/ /chom rkun 'byung zhing 'thab mo mang / /byes su 'chi dang nor lag zan/ /sgo la dngur gdong gtad pa la/ /stag dang nor bu 'khyil pa bri/ /ral po gru gsum brus la bsub/ /phyogs la zur song shing cha rnams/ /drang por phub pas bcos par bya/ /ma bcos tshe thung nor mi chags/ /'khor g.yog mi 'phel mi kha sdang / /phug mthos dkar khung mthos pa la/ /me tog rin chen 'phyang ba btags/ /khyams kyi stod las smad mtho na/ /rim bzhin rdo rje g.yu rung bri/ /snod las khyams smad shing bzang na/ /rim bzhin āḥdang hūm̐ re bri/ /gdung las phyam rnams sbom pa la/ /rim bzhin zla rdzogs zla tshes bri/ /ma bcos dpon g.yog go ldog cing / /pha la bu mi snyan pa dang / /khyo las chung ma dbang cher 'gro/ /phyi sgo gnyis byas bo sar bstan/ /sgo gong byang chen mchod rten bzhengs/

/sgo gong gdung bkal rtags brgyad bri/ /gzhan gyi khang zur zug pa la/ /lha babs mchod rten legs pa bzhengs/ /tshang bang gzhan las mthos na dmad/ /'khor sar rang 'thag btsugs 'khor na/ /khro bo'i drag sngags bris pas thub/ /bres la gdong btsugs bum gter gzhug /ro mchan bton la gter gzhug bsub/ /ma bcos nang 'thab 'bru mi smin/ /nor phyugs god che gang stongs yong / /khang bdag 'phos dang zhig mang la/ /'khor lo rtsibs lngar 'byung ba lnga'i/ /sngags bris rtse sman dkus la dril/ /rus sbal khog par rin chen bcas/ /bcug nas gdung la kha phyir bstan/ /g.yos ma gdung gi thad song dang / /nyal ba'i thad du gdung byung na/ /gdung la khram gsum bris pas thub/ /shing gi mgo mjug log pa la/ /shing lo bri bya ma bcos na/ /'khor 'chi na tsha 'byung phyir bcos/ /bug pa mang na bsris mi rme/ /sgo la bug mang nang tshags chung / /nang du brag cha 'byung ba dang / /shing kha hrag shar bstan pa dang / /phyam sna gdung sna phyir mthon dang / /phyi sgo byang ngam nub bstan dang / /khang pa gru gsum gyen la nar/ /ka ba kha yar rtsig zur mang / /nyi zla lan gnyis 'char ba dang / /nyi zla khal du bkal ba dang / /sgo kun thad kar zang thal rnams/ /nad dang sdug bsngal yid mi bde/ /mgron mang 'thab rtsod 'byung phyir bcos/ /spyir na yon tan mang ldan yang / /skyon chen gcig gis 'joms pa dang / /skyon mang de las ldog pa'i phyir/ /chos kun mnyam nyid du shes shing / /tshogs gnyis rgya chen sngon song ba'i/ /bshes gnyen yon tan kun ldan dang / /rten gsum byin rlabs khyad 'phags dang / /skyes bu bsod nams cher ldan pa'i/ /ngan dpyad mtha' dag thub par 'gyur/ /de phyir de dag 'bad pas btsal/ /shes pa'i skyon rnams legs par bcos/ /mi shes bzlog phyir dge la 'bad/ /yul khams bkra shis 'byung 'dod pas/ /shar du ljon shing khyad 'phags 'dzugs/ /lho ru bum gter bzang po gzhug

/nub tu rigs gsum mgon po brtsig /byang du mtshan ldan mchod rten bzhengs/ /bkra shis dge mtshan gzhan yang bya/ /zhes bstan pa rin po che yun ring du gnas pa dang / 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang / phan bde 'byung ba'i rten 'brel khyad par can yin pas/ legs par bslabs te blang dor bya'o/ /mjug ni legs par grub nas/ thog mar bzo bo rnams yon dang rdzongs la kha smras med par mnyes par bya zhing / rten gsum thams cad rab gnas dang mnga' gsol gyi bkra shis shing bstan par bya ba yin pas/ rab gnas kyi sngon du dgos pa'i gzungs zhugs ci dgos rnams ma 'chugs pa shin tu gal che ste/ dus phyis mkhas rloms bstan pa la dbang za ba dag gis rtog bzo mang du byas shing / rten bzhengs kyang phran tshags dar du song zhing / de dag la rang bzo'i gzungs gzhug byas pas phyin ci log tu song ba dag gis/ bod 'bangs 'thab rtsod kyis gang ba 'di'i dngos rgyu byas par nges pa'i phyir ro/ ༈ /des na gzungs zhugs spyir bshad pa dang / gnod sbyin 'khor lo bye brag tu bshad pa dang / des gnam rgyan gyi dkyil 'khor bri tshul bde blag tu grub pa'o/ /dang po ni/ sku gzugs dang mchod rten gyi nang du bzhugs par bya ba'i ring bsrel ni bzhir gsungs te/ sku gdung gi dang / yungs 'bru lta bu'i dang / sku bal gyi dang / chos sku'i ring bsrel te/ gdung rus rkyang pa dang / ring bsrel dngos dang / sku skra phyag sen dang / gzungs sngags rnams te/ dang po gsum ni gos dar ram/ ras gyi 'thum bzang por dri sman khyad par can dang bcas te rten gyi ji ltar mtho sar bzhugs shing / gang zag dman pa'i rus pa sogs ni rten gyi nang du bcug na/ de la gang zag khyad par can gyis phyag mchod mdzad pa'i tshe/ gang zag de la shin tu gnod par 'od bsrungs rdzogs byed kyi gtam rgyud las grub pas mi rung la/ gal te 'jug na lhar bskyed pa'i rus chog khyad par can byas te sā ts+tsha gdab pa'am/

yi ge'i snag tsha la bsre ba sogs byas na rung ngo / /de na dang po gsum ni/ sangs rgyas dngos sam/ de dang 'dra ba'i gang zag khyad par can gyi dbang du byas/ bzhi pa la stod smad kun tu rung ba'i gzungs chen bzhi'am lngar grags te/ gtsug tor rnam rgyal dang / dri med dang / byang chub rgyan 'bum dang / gsang ba ring bsrel rnams sam/ ye dharmā dang lnga'o/ /oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hā/ zhes pa srog shing brtan pa'i gzungs te mchod rten gyi srog shing la mang du bkri zhing / lha sku che ba rnams la'ang tsan+dan dkar po'am shug gsar sogs la gang ran byas te bkri bar bya'o/ /oṃ sarba bi d+yā swā hā/ zhes pa rig pa chen po'i gzungs ni mchod rten gyi bum pa dang lha'i thugs ka dang / thang ka'i yang rgyab kyi thugs ka'i thad du mang du bzhugs shing bri'o/ /gzhan yang mid pa snying / rna bar phyag rdor la sogs pa bskyed dam/ sku gsung thugs dang lus dkyil gyi lha la sogs pa'i snying po dang sa bon yang gnas de dang der gzhug par bya'o/ /gzhan yang dngos brgyud kyi bla ma'i mtshan/ oṃ āḥn mo badz+ra dha ra ya hūm̐/ zhes sogs 'bru gsum gyi dbus su tshud cing / na mo bzhi pa'i rnam dbye dang bcas pa rgya skad dag pa dang / mi shes na/ oṃ āḥrdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal lo hūm̐/ zhes sogs bod skad du byas pa'ang rung ste/ shong na mdo sngags kyi brgyud pa gang shong bu ston rin po ches bsgrigs pa'i gzungs 'bum na gang bzhugs kyi mjug tu/ oṃ āḥn mo rat+na sid+dha ye hūm̐/ de bzhin du/ puṇ+ya dh+wa dza shrī bha tra/ sha ra ṇa a gra shrī bha dra/ seng ha dh+wa sha shrī bha tra/ ā ka sha pra wa rnams sbyar te/ rin chen grub/ bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ skyabs mchog dpal bzang po/ seng ge rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ nam mkha' 'od zer rnams kyi bar dang spel tshig dang bcas te bris nas/ dbu'i nang du gang shong gzhug par bya'o/

/de'i 'og tu bla med kyi gtso bo dus kyi 'khor lo dang / kyai rdo rje gnyis su med pa'i rgyud dang / de nas ma rgyud bde mchog 'khor lo dang bcas pa dang / de nas pha rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa la sogs te bla med rnams thugs ka dang / de nas rnal 'byor rgyud rnams lte ba dang / bya spyod rnams sku'i smad dang / chos skyong dang nor lha rnams pad gdan la bzhugs te/ gzungs 'bul chen mo'i rim pa ji bzhin no/ /mi tshud na btus te ji ltar 'os par gzhug par byas la/ gzungs kun la'ang sngon du rab gnas bsdus pa re grub na'ang legs shing / ma grub kyang rung ste/ rab gnas dngos kyi dus su yig 'bru'i rab gnas rgyas par bya'o/ /rgyud sde'i rigs dbye la sogs par ni gzhan du mang po bris zin pas 'dir ma spros so/ /gzungs rnams kyang rab gser dngul/ 'bring zangs/ tha ma snag tshas bris pa'am spar du byas pa'ang rung ste/ yi ge dag pa shin tu gal che zhing / dbu gzungs rnams kyang gdung rus kyi bris pa'ang rung zhing / yi ge'ang rab lañja/ 'bring dbu can/ tha ma dbu med du bris pas kyang 'grub ste/ thams cad sgril lugs shin tu dam pa mi 'jig pa dang dbu zhabs mi ldog pa'i mtshan ma byas/ dri zhim po cung zad bkus/ rten gyi nang yang dri bzang po'i ko ba tsam byugs pa skams te bgegs bskrad gu gul gyi dud pa bdugs pa dang bcas pa byas nas/ blo shin tu zhib par stod gzungs smad gzungs rnams ma 'chol ba dang mgo mjug ma log par tshags shin tu dam pas gzhug par bya'o/ ༈ /gnyis pa la gzhan 'dod dgag pa ni/ phyis kyi bstan 'dzin rang bzo shes pa la mkhas par byed cing / rang gis myong ba dang mngon sum ltar snang rgyu mtshan du byas nas/ shin tu lkog gyur gyi zhal lugs lung rnam dag 'ba' zhig gis mjal dgos pa rnams la dbang za bar byed pa dag gi 'dod tshul du ma byas te/ kha cig gis pho 'khor steng du byas pa gzhir byas la/

gtso bo dbu shar bstan mdun nub bstan/ 'khor thams cad dbu nang bstan la 'og ma phyogs mtshams ji bzhin g.yas bskor dang / steng ma g.yon bskor du byas pa'i yab yum so sor zhal sbyor ba 'ong zhing / langs pa'i tshe pho phyi nas zhal nang bstan dang mo nang nas de la zhal bstan pa shog gu pad 'dab so sor bkol nas dras te sbyar nas grub pas/ 'di las lhag pa med do zhes zer zhing / deng sang lugs 'di shin tu dar bar 'gyur ro/ /kha cig steng 'khor g.yon bskor dgos pa bden mod kyi/ gtso bo dbu shar bstan du byas na/ zhal gang bstan shar du byed dgos pa dang 'gal zhing / shar gyi gtso 'khor gtso bo'i rgyab tu 'byung bas skyon yod pas/ dbu nub bstan yin la/ 'khor gyi dbu nang du bstan pa'ang phyin ci log yin pas/ phyir bstan du byed la/ de la langs pa'i tshe/ gtso bo yab yum zhal nub tu bstan la thod par mthong zhing / ༈ dpa' bo gcig sgrub kyi rgyud du/ mo 'khor nyis brtsegs kyi sgrub thabs bshad pa la brten pa dang / ras bris sgyel ba'i tshe pho 'og tu 'ong bar mngon sum gyis grub pa rgyu mtshan du byas nas/ mo rkyang nyis brtsegs ni dgos pa chung la/ pho gtso bor byed na mo 'og dang / mo gtso bor byed na pho 'og tu byas nas bri ba'i rnam bzhag rgyas par byed do/ /'di dag ni 'thad pa min te/ lung rig dang 'gal ba'i phyir ro/ /lung ni/ rten gyi gzungs zhugs la 'khor lo byed pa mi gsal yang / dpa' bo gcig sgrub tu/ spyir nor sgrub pa la/ gser dngul sogs kyi snod steng 'og la/ mo 'khor nyis sbyar ram/ pho 'khor sbyar bar bya ba gsungs pa'i steng 'og gnyis ka la phyogs dang phyogs bral g.yas bskor kho na bya bar gsungs pa 'dis/ khyed ltar na rdo rje 'chang gi gdul bya bslus par 'gyur te/ 'di la steng 'og mi 'grig pa mngon sum gyi grub pas nyes dmigs shin tu chen po yod pa gang zhig

rgyud dang mkhas pa'i gzhung kun tu skyon phra mo la'ang blang dor bya bar gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /steng 'khor la g.yon bskor bya ba dngos su ma gsungs kyang / don la mi byed dka' med do/ /gnyis ka g.yas bskor byas na shar lho'i lha dang byang shar gyi lha/ lho'i lha dang byang gi lha zhal sbyor du 'ong bar mngon sum gyis grub pa'i phyir ro/ /zhe na de ltar rig pa dang 'gal te/ logs bris dang 'dres sam/ thang ka'i steng gi lha gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba lta bu nub kyi nub tu bri bar ma gsungs kyi/ shar gyi shar du 'dri bar gsungs kyang / don la ldog dgos par gsungs te/ ma ldog de dkyil 'khor pa thams cad kyi 'og tu 'byung zhing / 'og gi gnod mdzes steng du 'byung bar mngon sum gyis grub pa'i phyir ro/ /lha shar phyogs pa thams cad dbu nang bstan du 'dri dgos par 'gyur te/ phyir bstan la mgo mjug log yong ba mngon sum gyis grub pa'i phyir/ khyad par gtso bo dbu shar bstan ni shin tu'ang tha chad de/ lugs phyi mas bkag pa ltar/ purba zhes pa shar dang mdun gnyis ka'i skad dod yin zhing / pañci ma zhes pa nub dang rgyab kyi skad dod yin pas ming gi rnam grangs yin par phyir rgyab tu kha bltas pa las skyon che ba ci zhig yod/ ༈ yig mgo nang du bstan pa ni/ rje btsun grags rgyal gyi sngon du'ang byung 'dug pa/ bla ma des las 'jam po gsum la yig mgo phyir bstan bya bar rgyud las gsungs pa dang 'gal zhes bkag pa bzhin du/ dus 'khor sogs su gsal bar 'byung ngo / /lugs phyi mas nyes pa 'di mthong nas zhal shar du bstan kyang steng 'khor g.yon du bskor bas skyon zhugs te/ g.yas sam shar rnam grangs yin pa las/ gtso bo'i g.yas kyi lha g.yon dang / g.yon gyi lha g.yas su 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /pho gtso bor gyur pa la/ pho 'og tu 'byung bar ras bris sgyel ba'i mngon sum gyis grub na lho nas kyang khas blangs dgos par 'gyur te/

kaka ṇi sogs kyi gnam rgyan la pho steng du 'byung bar mngon sum gyis grub pa'i phyir ro/ /mngon sum la rtsis byed na/ pho 'og tu mi rigs te/ 'og tu byas na pho mo go log par mngon sum gyis grub cing / de 'dra don thob kyi rigs pa dang 'jig rten gyi tha snyad thams cad dang 'gal ba'i phyir ro/ /de dag ni mngon sum phal pa la snang ba tsam yin gyi/ don la bzhengs nas pho mo zhal sbyor mdzad pa yin pas skyon med do zhe na/ de ltar na lho'i lha dang byang gi lha zhal sbyor bar mngon sum la bris pa phal pa la snang ba yin gyi/ don la lho'i pho mo dang byang gi pho mo zhal sbyor du 'ong pas shog ldebs lag tu bzung ba'i mngon sum la brten pa'i nga ro ma byed cig 'gal rtags 'di dag la 'dzems nas/ lder sku sogs kyi 'bur ma byed pa rnams kyang mi 'thad de/ rgyud du snod dam byang bu bris pa kha sbyar gyi bar du nor 'bru dang zas la sogs pa bcug te sbrang rtsis kha bsdams nas sgrub par nan gyis gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ ༈ /des na/ gang phyir rgyal las ches mkhas 'ga' yang 'jig rten dag na yod min te/ /de phyir drang srong rang nyid kyis bzhag mdo sde gang yin de mi dkrug /thub tshul bshig phyir de yang dam chos la ni gnod pa byed par 'gyur/ /zhes rgyud blar byams mgon gyis gsungs pa ni/ tshul lugs 'di 'dras mtshon nas/ rang bzos bstan pa 'dzin pa rnams la go rgyu re nas gsungs pa'o/ /gzhan yang mngon sum phal pa la steng 'og ji bzhin ma 'grig pas/ thabs shes ma 'grig pa sogs kyi skyon byung na/ steng 'og gang rung gi yi ge rnams kyang go ldog dgos par 'byung zhing / de ltar 'dod cing lag len la 'gel na/ yab yum thabs shes sbyor ba'i tshe/ g.yas zhal dang g.yas zhal/ phyag zhabs g.yas pa dang g.yas pa/ nu ma g.yas pa dang g.yas pa sogs mi 'grig pas/ yab yum gang rung gcig gi g.yas g.yon thams cad go ldog dgos par 'gyur zhing /

༈ thang sku'i rgyab yig sogs la'ang / yig log bri dgos par 'gyur te nyes pa mtshon pas chog go ༈ /des na rang nyid kyi lugs ni/ dpa' bo gcig sgrub kyi rgyud le'u gnyis pa las/ oṃ ba su dhā ri ṇ+yai swā hā/ oṃ tsan+t+ra kan t+yā+ai swā hā/ oṃ dad tā ye swā hā/ oṃ su dad tā yai swā hā/ oṃ ār+ya yai swā hā/ oṃ su bhā trā yai swā hā/ oṃ gup+ta yai swā hā/ oṃ de wai swā hā/ oṃ swa ra swa t+yā swā hā/ gser gyi snod dang zangs ma'i snod rnams kyang rung ste/ 'dab ma brgyad pa'i dbus su nor 'dzin ma dang / shar la sogs pa'i phyogs bzhi dang phyogs bral gyi 'dab ma rnams la tsan+ti kan+ti la sogs pa'i gnod sbyin chen mo rnams mngon par bris pa'i snod gnyis kha sbyor te/ mar dang sbrang rtsi dang ka ra rnams bcug nas sngar gsungs pa'i cho gas/ sngar gsungs pa'i las thams cad byed do/ /oṃ dzam+bha la dza len tra ye swā hā/ oṃ ma ṇi bha tra ya swā hā/ oṃ su rba bha tra ya swā hā/ oṃ dha na dā ya swā hā/ oṃ bai shra wa ṇa ya swā hā/ phyogs su'o/ /phyogs bral du/ oṃ kī li mā li ni swā hā/ oṃ pi tsi kun+dha li ya swā hā/ oṃ mu khen tra ya swā hā/ oṃ tsa rin+t+ra ya swā hā/ gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po chen po brgyad kyis yongs su bskor ba/ ba su dhā ri dang bcas pa'i bcom ldan 'das gser gyi mdog can ne'u le dang bīn dza pū ra 'dzin pa gsus pa 'phyang ba/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa sngar gsungs pa'i gnod sbyin mo rnams dang bcas pa'i gnod sbyin gyi dbang pos/ 'jig rten gsum gyi rgyal srid ster bar 'gyur ro/ /thun gsum du mngon par mchod de/ bsam gtan dang bzlas pa bya zhing / tho rang chu khyor ba brgya rtsa brgyad byin la/ bya rog gi sgra mi sgrag pa na chu yi nang du zhugs te bzlas pa byed pa de'i nor dang 'byor pa mi zad par 'gyur ro/

/yang na gser la sogs pa'i snod du ba su dha ra gnod sbyin mo dang bcas pa dang / snod gnyis pa la bcom ldan 'das dzam+bha la gnod sbyin rnams kyis yongs su bskor ba bris nas kha sbyor byas te mnyes par byas nas/ grub pa chen po brgyad kyang ster bar 'gyur na dngos grub gzhan rnams lta ci smos/ zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar na pho la/ ma ṇi bha tra sogs shar nas phyogs dang / kī li mā li la sogs pa bzhi phyogs bral la 'khod pa dang / mo la'ang / dang po bzhi dang phyi ma bzhi de dang 'dra bar gsungs la/ rgyud sde 'di rnams su g.yon du bskor ba'i rnam bzhag gcig kyang med pas/ g.yas bskor dang / phyogs shar nas mgo rtsom pa bzhin du/ mtshams me nas rtsom pa sha stag yin pas/ cho ga la sogs pa'i 'gros mi gsal ba rnams skabs kyi rgyud gang yin rnams kyis ji lta ba bzhin sbyar dgos kyi rgyud sde gong 'og bde mchog la sogs pa'i rgyas bkab mi rung ste/ 'di bya rgyud rigs drug gi nang nas/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rigs/ de la yang de bzhin gshegs pa dang pad+ma dang rdo rje'i rigs gsum gyi nang nas dang po/ de la yang rigs kyi gtso bo dang / 'khor los bsgyur ba dang / yum dang gtsug tor dang / sems dpa' sems ma la sogs mang ba'i nang nas/ 'khor los bsgyur ba 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud dang sbrel bar bya ba/ 'jam dpal dpa' bo gcig sgrub tu grags pa'i phyir ro/ /spyir dzam+bha la gcig nyid cho ga dang bla med kyi'ang gsang 'dus dang dus 'khor sogs nas bshad pa'i sgrub thabs mang bas skabs 'dir ni dpa' bo gcig sgrub la rten dgos te/ bya spyod kyi gzungs thams cad kyi 'og tu bla med kyi lha sngags gzhag tu mi rung ba'i phyir ro/ /des na rten gang yin gyi zhabs dang tshad pa'i gser dngul zangs kyi 'dab ma'i shog gu sogs la pad+ma 'dab brgyad bris pa'i lte ba la gtso bo yab yum dang /

'dab ma la rgyud las bshad pa de rnams ji skad brjod pa bzhin go rim dang yi ge 'bru len ma nor ba shin tu dag pa bris pa swā hā'i gong du/ dha na bru haṃ shrī bhū ti puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru zhes pa'i spel tshig rgyas bsdus gang shong / mi shong na sngags rkyang pa/ de yang ma shong na/ yab dgu la dzaṃ dang / yum dgu la bam̐ yig rkyang pa rung ste/ gtso bo yab yum dbu nub bstan dang / zhal shar bstan/ 'khor thams cad dbu phyir bstan dang zhal nang bstan du byas pa bri zhing / shong na phyi ru mu khyud gsum rim gyis nang ma la dbyangs gsal/ bar ma la ye dhār/ phyi ma la rdo rwa/ de'i mthar me ri'ang rung ste/ dbyangs gsal ni sngags thams cad kyi gzhi la/ ye dharmā ni stod smad kun tu ji ltar mang gin bzang ba'i phyir dang / rdo rwa me ri ni rgyud kyi lha thams cad kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i phyir dang / shong na lha bris pa'i thugs kar sngags bris na'ang rung la/ lha ni yab thams cad g.yas bi dza pu ra dang / g.yon ne'u le/ yum thams cad g.yas mchog sbyin dang / g.yon rin po che'i snye ma 'dzin pa/ gsus pa che ba la sogs pa gnod sbyin gyi nyams dang ldan pa'o/ /legs par grub nas kha sbyar gyi nang du rin po che dang / gos dar/ 'bru dang zas la sogs pa bzang dgu gang shong bcug sbrang dang ka ra dang mar gyis kha sbyar te/ pho 'khor steng dang mo 'khor 'og gtso bo yab yum gyi mdun phyogs su 'ong bar byas la/ dar dmar pos dril nas ma nor bar gzhug go ༈ /gsum pa rtsod pa spang ba ni/ 'o na bu ston thams cad mkhyen pas yig mgo phyir bstan mdzad kyang lho byang go ldog steng 'khor la byed pa man ngag yin gsungs pa dang / bla ma dam pas kyang steng ma g.yon bskor dang / 'khor gyi yig mgo nang bstan mdzad pa ma yin nam zhe na/ phyi mas de ltar mdzad pa'i yig cha ma mthong la/ mdzad du chug kyang sla ste/ de dag bstan 'dzin gyi gtso bo yin mod kyi/

dus dang bstan pa'i sku chags kyi dbang gis yi ger bris pa la 'khrul pa cung zad srid pas gang gsungs khas mi blang ngo / /rgyu mtshan ni sngar rgyas par bshad pa'i rigs pa rnams la lan gsung rgyu med pa'i phyir dang / ༈ rje btsun gong ma rnams dang yang 'gal ba'i phyir ro/ /yang kha cig steng 'khor g.yon bskor dgos te/ kaka ṇi'i dkyil 'khor sogs la sa rgyan dang gnam rgyan gyi khyad par sogs kyis/ lho byang go ldog dgos kyi/ lag len la yang byed pa mang gis/ khyed kyis bshad pa ni byed mkhan nyung bas mi 'thad do zhe na/ dgos pa gang gis sgrub/ rgyud dang rgya gzhung gi lung ni med/ man ngag yin gsung ba la ni lan brjod zin to/ /rig pas grub ste ma slog na 'jig rten spyi'i lho byang dang mi mthun pa'i phyir zhe na/ lho byang la sogs pa'i phyogs thams cad ltos 'jog kho na yin la/ 'dir ltos pa'i gtso bo ni/ rang rang sa'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo de yin gyi/ 'jig rten spyi dang bstun don med cing / gtso bo'i g.yas g.yon ldog pa'i skyon 'byung bas mi 'thad do/ /mi 'byung ste gtso bo'i dbu shar la ston no zhe na/ rgyab mdun log pas de las kyang skyon che'o zhes brjod zin to/ /mang bas nyung ba sun 'byin pa mi nus te/ dag pa dang ma dag pa gnyis phyi ma ches mang ba'i phyir te/ shes pa dang mi shes pa gnyis phyi ma shin tu'ang mang ba'i phyir ro/ ༈ /gsum pa ni/ de ltar na gnam rgyan gyi dkyil 'khor yang / sa rgyan ji bzhin du bris nas/ steng du sbyar bar bya ba yin gyi/ mngon sum ltar snang gi 'khrul pa bskyed par mi bya'o/ /de ltar na lho byang 'chugs pa dang / 'khor gyi lha rnams bzhengs pa'i tshe/ dbu 'thur du 'phyangs par 'gyur bas/ sa rgyan dang mi 'dra bar/ gnam rgyan la ni 'khor gyi lha rnams dbu nang bstan du bya dgos so/ /zhes kha cig lag len du yang byed do/ /de la ni/

de ltar na gnam rgyan gyi dkyil 'khor la mda' yab nang du bri dgos par 'gyur bas rgyan ltar bris na/ bslang ba'i tshe bre kha spub pa ltar 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /'dod na de 'dra'i dkyil 'khor ni rdo rje 'chang gis kyang mi mkhyen no/ /skyon med par snang / de nyid du bsgyur nas steng du ldang bas so zhe na/ rten gyen du langs nas/ brten pa mgo mthur du 'phyangs yong par gzigs pa de 'dra'i blos long ngo mtshar che'o/ /de ltar legs par grub nas rab gnas kyi cho ga dge legs rgya mtshor ji skad bshad pa'i cho ga thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa skabs su gang babs kyi rab gnas legs par bya'o/ /de ltar na rab gnas bya ba'i rten gyi sgrub tshul mdo tsam brjod pa ste/ shin tu rgyas par ni rdo rje slob dpon chen po dag gi spyod yul yin pas/ da ltar gyi slob dpon rnams kyi yul las 'das shing / yi ge mang gis dogs pas ma spros so/ ༈ /phan bde'i rtsa ba thub bstan nam mkha'i ngogs/ /rten gsum dge 'dun sde dang bcas pa yi/ /nyi zla rgyu skar snang bas khyab phyir du/ /de dag sgrub tshul dpal 'byor rgya mtsho 'di/ /shes bya'i gnas kun lhag pa'i mun bral ba/ /ji bzhin snang byed blo gros rta ljang can/ /phan bde'i pad tshal cher rgyas 'dod pa yi/ /skad gnyis smra ba pra dz+nya rat+nas sbyar/ /'dis mtshon dge ba'i gzi 'od du ma 'bar/ /mi shes mun pa'i dgra las rnam rgyal ste/ /chos kyi rgyal srid gling la dbang bsgyur ba'i/ /chos kyi rgyal po'i nyi mar bdag gyur cig /myos ldan gyi lo snron gyi zla ba'i bcu dgu mchod pa la grub pa'o// //maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 16 stag tshang lo tsā ba/ rten gsum bzhengs tshul/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 15
